Q_OBLIVION_A_DARK_EXILE: Sithis sends the Wrath of Sithis to reclaim your soul after breaking the Tenets. (A) Slay the apparition in brutal single combat: purges your dishonor in the eyes of the Dark Brotherhood, but scars your soul with an eternal chill. (B) Banish the phantom using consecration rites: defies Sithis's supernatural reach, severing your dark gift and turning the Sanctuary permanently hostile. (C) Surrender a portion of your life force or a willing retainer in appeasement: avoids mortal combat at the expense of an innocent ally's damnation.
Q_OBLIVION_A_KISS_BEFORE_DYING: Ungolim visits the Lucky Old Lady statue in Bravil every evening, unaware he is the Listener. (A) Snipe Ungolim from the shadows of the statue: secures the contract cleanly, but fulfills Mathieu Bellamont's deception and leaves the Black Hand headless. (B) Confront Ungolim before striking: uncovers that he believes you are an assassin sent by traitors, offering a fleeting window to halt the purge before imperial guards intervene. (C) Subdue Ungolim and conceal him: fakes the Listener's death to expose the dead drop mastermind while forfeiting immediate Sanctuary payment.
Q_OBLIVION_A_KNIFE_IN_THE_DARK: Lucien Lachance tasks you with executing Rufio at the Inn of Ill Omen as your initiation. (A) Execute the frail, terrified Rufio in his sleep: fulfills the test ruthlessly and secures induction into the Cheydinhal Sanctuary without incident. (B) Interrogate Rufio about his past victim: learns the wretched crime that placed the Black Sacrament upon his head before delivering cold justice. (C) Spare Rufio and stage his demise: defies the Dark Brotherhood at inception, earning Lucien Lachance's immediate nocturnal retribution.
Q_OBLIVION_A_MATTER_OF_HONOR: Alval Uvani, a wandering Dunmer merchant and covert Black Hand Silencer, is marked for death. (A) Poison his mead with mead-soaked frost salts during his tavern stops: causes an undetectable, agonizing demise fulfilling the bonus criteria. (B) Engage Uvani in open magical duel on the road: risks high-level Destruction collateral on traveling merchants while testing your martial prowess. (C) Corner Uvani in his Leyawiin retreat and demand to see his Silencer orders: exposes that the dead drops are orchestrating the internal slaughter of the Black Hand.
Q_OBLIVION_A_WATERY_GRAVE: Captain Gaston Tussaud must be eliminated aboard the Marie Elena in the Imperial City Waterfront. (A) Infiltrate through the lower cargo hold and assassinate Tussaud in his cabin: claims the contract and captain's key while evading the pirate crew. (B) Incite a mutiny among the crew on deck: turns the pirate deckhands against their captain, causing chaos that draws Captain Lex's Watchmen into Waterfront bloodshed. (C) Bribe Tussaud into faking his murder and abandoning Cyrodiil: spares the smuggler for future illicit maritime contraband, risking Brotherhood retribution.
Q_OBLIVION_ACCIDENTS_HAPPEN: Baenlin must die inside his Bruma manor via a staged accident with a mounted Minotaur head. (A) Loosen the fastenings from the crawlspace precisely when Baenlin sits: stages a flawless accidental death, securing the hefty bonus and leaving his manservant Gromm grief-stricken. (B) Execute Baenlin in hand-to-hand combat: forfeits the bonus but spares Gromm the psychological torment of feeling responsible. (C) Plant forged evidence framing Gromm for the murder: diverts imperial suspicion away from the Brotherhood while ruining an innocent servant's life.
Q_OBLIVION_AFFAIRS_OF_A_WIZARD: The necromancer Celedaen is conducting lichdom ascension in The Dark Fissure. (A) Pickpocket his Sands of Resolve to induce instant organ failure: destroys the necromancer effortlessly without awakening his undead thralls. (B) Confront Celedaen in his ritual circle and shatter his soul gems: provokes a chaotic necromantic explosion that collapses the cavern entrance. (C) Steal Celedaen's lichdom research notes for yourself: secures forbidden necromantic formulas before slaying him, increasing Arcane University hostility.
Q_OBLIVION_BAD_MEDICINE: Roderick lies ill at Fort Sutch, guarded by loyal mercenaries, taking daily medicine. (A) Swap Roderick's medicine bottle with poisoned brew unnoticed: ensures a quiet, natural-looking demise and collects the bonus cleanly. (B) Slit Roderick's throat and butcher the mercenary garrison: leaves a gory calling card that puts Imperial authorities on high alert. (C) Inform the mercenary captain that someone put a contract on Roderick: triggers an internal panic, fracturing the warband while forfeiting Brotherhood standing.
Q_OBLIVION_BROKEN_VOWS: J'Ghasta the Khajiit boxer and secret Black Hand member resides in Bruma. (A) Ambush J'Ghasta in his secret basement training room: neutralizes a lethal hand-to-hand combatant before he can react. (B) Confront J'Ghasta regarding his loyalty to the Night Mother: reveals he believes he is answering legitimate orders from the Speaker, casting doubt on the dead drops. (C) Poison his training kegs: eliminates the target cleanly but denies yourself the chance to inspect his hidden Black Hand documents.
Q_OBLIVION_DARKNESS_ETERNAL: Vicente Valtieri offers the dark gift of vampirism as a sign of affection and kinship. (A) Accept the Dark Gift of Porphyric Hemophilia: gains supernatural strength, stealth, and night eye at the permanent cost of sun vulnerability and social stigma. (B) Decline respectfully: maintains mortal humanity and paladin compatibility while preserving Vicente's mentorship. (C) Betray Vicente's vampiric nature to the Order of the Virtuous Blood: sparks a clandestine purge within Cheydinhal, compromising the Sanctuary.
Q_OBLIVION_FINAL_JUSTICE: Shaleez the Argonian hunter lurks in the flooded flooded ruins of Flooded Mine. (A) Stalk and drown Shaleez in underwater combat: executes the contract in her native element, demonstrating absolute predatory dominance. (B) Lure Shaleez into the mine's collapse traps: dispatches her efficiently without risking drowning, but buries her rare enchanted gear. (C) Parley with Shaleez to ascertain her dead-drop connection: uncovers that she too received instructions from an unknown courier before combat ensues.
Q_OBLIVION_FOLLOWING_A_LEAD: You discover the dead drops have been swapped to orchestrate the murder of the Black Hand. (A) Stake out the next drop in Anvil and trail Enilroth: uncovers Mathieu Bellamont's trail to Applewatch and rushes to save Lucien Lachance. (B) Report the dead drop tampering immediately to the remaining Black Hand: faces skepticism from Arquen and risks being branded a traitor yourself. (C) Execute Enilroth to tie up loose ends: prevents Bellamont from learning he was discovered, but loses critical testimony proving Lucien's innocence.
Q_OBLIVION_HONOR_THY_MOTHER: In the Crypt of the Night Mother, Mathieu Bellamont reveals his treason and attacks the surviving Black Hand. (A) Strike down Bellamont before the Night Mother's sarcophagus: avenges Lucien Lachance, secures the title of Listener, and earns the Blade of Woe's awakening. (B) Shield Arquen from Bellamont's initial onslaught: prevents the loss of another Speaker at the cost of absorbing devastating necrotic spells. (C) Question the Night Mother on why she permitted the purge of her children: extracts chilling eldritch truth about cosmic indifference at the risk of divine censure.
Q_OBLIVION_NEXT_OF_KIN: Perennia Draconis and her four scattered children must all be eradicated. (A) Deceive Perennia into giving you the gift list containing her children's locations before executing her: completes the contract with surgical efficiency across Cyrodiil. (B) Warn one of the children (Caelia in the Leyawiin guard or Matthias in Imperial City): breaks the contract to save an honorable soldier, triggering a Brotherhood executioner on your trail. (C) Frame the Draconis killings as a bandit feud: shields the Brotherhood from provincial scrutiny while terrorizing the local peasantry.
Q_OBLIVION_PERMANENT_RETIREMENT: Adamus Phillida, retired Imperial Legion commander, swims guarded in Leyawiin's pond. (A) Strike Phillida with the Rose of Sithis while unarmored in the water: fulfills the contract instantaneously and claims his severed finger for the bonus. (B) Break into the Imperial Legion barracks to place his severed finger on his successor's desk: sends a terror shockwave through the Legion, driving Cyrodiil guards into frantic crackdowns. (C) Spare Phillida and stage a drowned corpse: allows the veteran to retire in peaceful exile, risking total dishonor with the Black Hand.
Q_OBLIVION_SCHEDULED_FOR_EXECUTION: Valen Dreth, the Dunmer prisoner who mocked you in the tutorial dungeons, awaits execution. (A) Infiltrate the Imperial Prison via the sewers without killing a single guard: fulfills Valtieri's bonus criteria and delivers poetic justice to Dreth in his cell. (B) Free Valen Dreth from his cell before executing him in the sewers: forces him to realize his survival was an illusion before snuffing him out. (C) Bribe the dungeon guard to let Dreth escape into Cyrodiil: spares your former tormentor for extortion, forfeiting the Scales of Pitiless Justice.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_ASSASSINATED_MAN: Francois Motierre owes huge debts to underworld loansharks and needs to fake his death with Languorwine. (A) Slash Motierre with the Languorwine blade and protect his comatose body from his creditors: earns his enchanted amulet and maintains the Brotherhood's reputation for deceptive contracts. (B) Double-cross Motierre and use a lethal poisoned blade: satisfies the underworld syndicate for a massive gold payout while breaking Valtieri's contract terms. (C) Confront the syndicate enforcer Hides-His-Eyes directly in Chorrol: turns the streets into a bloody skirmish, drawing the Chorrol guard into the fray.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_COLDEST_SLEEP: Havilstein Hoar-Blood, a Nord barbarian encampment leader, lives atop the snowy Gnoll Mountain. (A) Ambush Havilstein while he sleeps beside his wolf companion: avoids a brutal melee battle against his enchanted frost battleaxe. (B) Challenge Havilstein to an honorable duel of warriors: tests your martial prowess against a mountain warlord, but risks alerting nearby mountain bandits. (C) Subdue his loyal wolf Red and turn it against him: exploits his sentimental weakness at the cost of emotional brutality.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_LONELY_WANDERER: Faelian, an addicted Altmer noble, roams the Imperial City Waterfront and Elven Gardens. (A) Provide Faelian with Skooma to isolate him in Lorkan Botho's abandoned house: executes him quietly away from Imperial Watch patrols to secure the bonus. (B) Execute Faelian openly in the Elven Gardens: fulfills the contract swiftly but provokes an immediate Imperial Guard bounty and loses the bonus. (C) Help his lover Atraena convince him to flee Cyrodiil: spares Faelian in exchange for hidden family jewels, betraying the Black Sacrament.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_PURIFICATION: Lucien Lachance commands you to purge the entire Cheydinhal Sanctuary to cleanse a traitor. (A) Systematically slaughter Ocheeva, Vicente, Antoinetta, Gogron, and Teinaava: fulfills the dark command unquestioningly, earning Shadowmere and the rank of Silencer. (B) Poison the Sanctuary's shared food stores with poisoned apples: eliminates your family painlessly in their sleep, minimizing combat trauma. (C) Attempt to warn Ocheeva or Vicente of Lucien's order: discovers that Sanctuary wards prevent escape, forcing a tragic fratricide under Sithis's watchful gaze.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_RENEGADE_SHADOWSCALE: Teinaava secretly asks you to hunt down his rogue Shadowscale brother Scar-Tail in Bogwater. (A) Hunt Scar-Tail down and carve out his heart for Teinaava: upholds the ancient Argonian Shadowscale tradition and claims Teinaava's reward. (B) Accept Scar-Tail's offer to take a dead Argonian agent's heart instead: spares the fugitive to live in peace, deceiving Teinaava with forged biological proof. (C) Slay both Scar-Tail and his pursuer to keep Scar-Tail's buried hoard: maximizes personal wealth while extinguishing the last remnants of the Bogwater clan.
Q_OBLIVION_WHISPERS_OF_DEATH: As Listener, you receive weekly prayers from the Lucky Old Lady to assign contracts to Arquen. (A) Relay the prayers faithfully to Arquen each week: maintains steady Sanctuary income and establishes an orderly network of assassinations. (B) Suppress certain horrific contracts involving innocent children: quietly alters the Night Mother's directives, asserting mortal morality over cosmic death worship. (C) Exploit the prayers for personal blackmail before forwarding targets: doubles personal gold revenue while risking Sithis's supernatural retribution.
Q_OBLIVION_WHODUNIT: Five guests are locked in Summitmist Manor seeking a nonexistent treasure, and you must kill them all unseen. (A) Manipulate the guests' paranoia through dialogue until they turn on and kill each other: achieves a masterpiece of psychological warfare and collects the Night Mother's blessing. (B) Pick them off one by one in dark corners and bedrooms: executes a methodical slasher sequence without alerting the survivors. (C) Reveal yourself as the Dark Brotherhood assassin in the parlor: provokes a frantic, desperate five-on-one melee battle that forfeits the stealth bonus.
Q_OBLIVION_A_MAGES_STAFF: Necromancers have slaughtered the mages at Wellspring Cave to seize enchanted staff-wood. (A) Slay the necromancer infiltrators and carve your custom staff: secures your official Mage's Staff from Delmar and earns promotion to Journeyman. (B) Study the corrupted dark sap residue left in the wellspring: gains rare insights into Worm Cult enchantment at the risk of Delmar detecting tainted wood. (C) Pursue the fleeing necromancer couriers into the surrounding forest: intercepts intercepted communication intended for Mannimarco before reporting back to Traven.
Q_OBLIVION_A_PLOT_REVEALED: The Bruma Mages Guild is found burning and gutted by Mannimarco's necromancers, with J'skar in hiding. (A) Slay the necromancer Camilla Lollia and escort traumatized J'skar to the Imperial City: delivers crucial eyewitness intelligence regarding Mannimarco's return to Arch-Mage Traven. (B) Search the charred remnants of the guild library for Jeanne Frasoric's missing ledger: uncovers evidence of internal guild negligence and leaks before fleeing the blaze. (C) Track the necromancer strike force's retreat toward Echo Cave: risks an ambush to delay their convergence on other guild halls.
Q_OBLIVION_ALCHEMY_ACQUISITIONS: Julienne Fanis offers the use of the Arch-Mage's Enchanted Chest to replicate rare alchemical flora weekly. (A) Duplicate rare Nirnroot and Daedric ingredients exclusively for guild reserves: bolsters university potion stocks and solidifies your academic legacy. (B) Duplicate dangerous poisonous nightshade and harvest toxins for illicit sale: floods Cyrodiil black markets with lethal tinctures for massive personal wealth. (C) Experiment with duplicating volatile Daedric hearts: tests the Enchanted Chest's metaphysical limits, risking an arcane backlash in the Arch-Mage's quarters.
Q_OBLIVION_AMBUSH: Battlemages lay an ambush at Silorn to intercept Falcar and seize a colossal Black Soul Gem. (A) Command the battlemages in a coordinated tactical assault: minimizes imperial casualties and secures the Colossal Black Soul Gem intact for Traven. (B) Charge ahead alone to duel Falcar personally: avenges his treason at Cheydinhal and claims his unique enchanted rings, but leaves the battlemages exposed. (C) Allow Falcar to attempt the soul-trap ritual on an apprentice: observes the dark resonance mechanics firsthand before disrupting the spell and taking the gem.
Q_OBLIVION_ANVIL_RECOMMENDATION: Carahil suspects a rogue mage is murdering merchants along the Gold Road with frost spells. (A) Stake out the Brina Cross Inn and protect the disguised battlemage from Caminalda: neutralizes the rogue frost mage and secures Carahil's glowing recommendation. (B) Confront Caminalda privately in her room before she strikes: attempts to turn the rogue mage into an informant against rogue hedge mages. (C) Use merchant caravans as bait to trap Caminalda's accomplices: ensures total eradication of the highwaymen network at the cost of terrifying civilian merchants.
Q_OBLIVION_BRAVIL_RECOMMENDATION: Ardaline's Mages Staff was stolen by a lovesick guildmate, Varon Vamori, who fled to the Imperial City. (A) Use charm spells or persuasion to coax the staff back from Varon peacefully: preserves guild unity and earns Kud-Ei's recommendation without embarrassing the apprentices. (B) Threaten Varon with disciplinary expulsion to seize the staff: establishes strict guild authority but alienates lower-ranking students. (C) Pawn the stolen staff to an underworld fence in the Waterfront: frames Varon for grand theft to extort favors from both Kud-Ei and the Council.
Q_OBLIVION_BRUMA_RECOMMENDATION: Jeanne Frasoric demands you find J'skar, who has cast a permanent invisibility spell to prank the guild. (A) Cast Dispel or detect life to reveal J'skar and break his prank: satisfies Jeanne's petty requirement and secures her quick recommendation. (B) Conspire with Volanaro to teach Jeanne a lesson about basic magical theory: humbles the incompetent chapter head while winning the devotion of the Bruma apprentices. (C) Report Volanaro's unauthorized illusion tricks directly to the Council: cracks down on guild hazing but sows bitter resentment in the Bruma hall.
Q_OBLIVION_CHEYDINHAL_RECOMMENDATION: Falcar sends you to retrieve a heavy Ring of Burden from the bottom of a flooded well, where an apprentice drowned. (A) Cast Buoyancy, retrieve the Ring of Burden, and expose Falcar's murder of Vidkun: forces Falcar to flee Cheydinhal and secures Deetsan's recommendation. (B) Search Falcar's private chambers to find his stash of Black Soul Gems: provides the Council with damning proof of necromancy within guild ranks. (C) Keep the Ring of Burden and use it as a lethal drowning weapon: exploits the enchanted artifact while disguising your discovery of Falcar's treason.
Q_OBLIVION_CONFRONT_THE_KING: Arch-Mage Hannibal Traven sacrifices his soul into the Colossal Black Soul Gem to shield you from Mannimarco. (A) March into Echo Cave and slay the King of Worms Mannimarco: eradicates the necromantic threat, becomes the Arch-Mage of Cyrodiil, and claims the Staff of Worms. (B) Attempt to bind Mannimarco's essence into the Colossal Gem alongside Traven: traps both arch-mages in eternal metaphysical stasis, preventing future resurrections. (C) Offer Mannimarco an uneasy truce in exchange for the secrets of eternal lichdom: betrays Traven's sacrifice and ushers in an era of shadow within the Arcane University.
Q_OBLIVION_FINGERS_OF_THE_MOUNTAIN: Both Earana and Teekeeus vie for the ancient tome 'Fingers of the Mountain' found on Cloud Top. (A) Hand the tome to Teekeeus: upholds orthodox guild discipline, earns his recommendation, and keeps dangerous shock magic out of reckless hands. (B) Hand the tome to Earana: unlocks the catastrophic 'Fingers of the Mountain' lightning spell at the cost of disciplinary tension with Teekeeus. (C) Steal the tome back from Teekeeus after getting the recommendation and give it to Earana: plays both factions against each other, maximizing magical power and guild standing.
Q_OBLIVION_INFORMATION_AT_A_PRICE: Count Janus Hassildor of Skingrad demands you eliminate a coven of vampires and vampire hunters before giving intel on Mannimarco. (A) Slay both the Bloodcrust Cavern vampires and the oblivious vampire hunters: cleanses Skingrad's outskirts completely and secures Hassildor's vital warning regarding the King of Worms. (B) Pit the vampire hunters directly against Bloodcrust Cavern: lets both factions destroy each other with zero guild risk, though innocent hunters perish. (C) Blackmail Count Hassildor regarding his own vampiric nature: extorts vast gold and arcane secrets from the Count, risking his immense wrath.
Q_OBLIVION_JOIN_THE_MAGES_GUILD: To enter the Arcane University, you must travel to all seven provincial guild halls to earn recommendations. (A) Methodically complete all seven chapter tasks with honor and skill: earns unanimous council respect and unlocks unrestricted access to the University's laboratories. (B) Fast-track recommendations using charm magic and political leverage: gains immediate entrance while leaving lingering doubts regarding your academic legitimacy. (C) Study the unique regional magical specialties of each city hall along the way: deepens your understanding of elemental and mystical arts before facing the Council.
Q_OBLIVION_LEYAWIIN_RECOMMENDATION: Dagail suffers from mad psychic visions because her ancestral Seer's Stone was stolen by the jealous Agata or Kalthar. (A) Expose Kalthar, slay him when he attacks in Fort Blueblood, and return the Seer's Stone: restores Dagail's sanity and secures her proud recommendation. (B) Keep the Seer's Stone for its divinatory clairvoyance: grants supernatural danger foresight at the cost of leaving Dagail tormented by maddening whispers. (C) Frame the local Leyawiin Khajiit population for the theft: covers for guild infighting while inflaming racial tension along the Southern border.
Q_OBLIVION_LIBERATION_OR_APPREHENSION: Traven tasks you with securing battlemage informant Mucianus Allias from the necromancers at Nenyond Twyll. (A) Discover Mucianus transformed into an undead zombie and put him to rest: brings tragic closure, reports the horror to Traven, and avenges the fallen battlemages. (B) Capture the lead necromancer Mariette Rielle alive for interrogation: extracts vital operational maps of Mannimarco's cell network before executing her. (C) Attempt to reverse Mucianus's zombie curse with experimental restoration: risks severe arcane corruption in a desperate bid to save an imperial patriot.
Q_OBLIVION_MAGES_GUILD_SUSPENSION: Having broken guild rules or stolen from colleagues, you must collect rare flora to earn reinstatement. (A) Gather 20 Dragon's Tongue and 20 Redwort Flowers through grueling wilderness foraging: demonstrates humble penance and earns clean restoration of guild privileges. (B) Buy the ingredients from underworld smugglers or black-market apothecaries: circumvents manual labor through gold, proving commercial resourcefulness over remorse. (C) Infiltrate the Arch-Mage's herbarium at night to steal the restitution plants: commits further brazen theft under the Council's noses to cheat the suspension penalty.
Q_OBLIVION_NECROMANCERS_MOON: Traven needs proof of how the Order of the Black Worm creates Black Soul Gems during the Shade of the Revenant. (A) Stake out the altar at Dark Fissure and observe the celestial purple beam corrupting Grand Soul Gems: secures undeniable written evidence for Traven without shedding blood. (B) Ambush the Worm Anchorite during the ritual and seize the newly created Black Soul Gem: claims the dark conduit for yourself, risking retribution from necromancer reinforcements. (C) Perform the dark ritual yourself using the altar: masters the forbidden alchemy of soul-corruption, setting you on the path of necromantic mastery.
Q_OBLIVION_SKINGRAD_RECOMMENDATION: Erthor has gone missing in Bleak Flats Cave while practicing dangerous fireball spells in isolation. (A) Clear the deranged zombies from Bleak Flats Cave and escort Erthor safely home to Skingrad: earns Adrienne Berene's recommendation and protects a timid scholar. (B) Force Erthor to fight his own way out: forces the reclusive mage to overcome his cowardice through fire, risking his life in the tunnels. (C) Confiscate Erthor's research journals on destructive pyromancy: claims unique fireball formulas for your spellbook before returning him to the hall.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_BLOODWORM_HELM: The legendary necromantic relic, the Bloodworm Helm, must be retrieved from Fort Teleman before Mannimarco's forces claim it. (A) Slay the necromancers and recover the Bloodworm Helm from Irlav Jarol's corpse: secures the artifact for Traven's vault, denying Mannimarco a key ritual focus. (B) Don the Bloodworm Helm and harness its terrifying control over undead: turns the cavern's skeletons against the necromancers at the expense of necrotic soul blight. (C) Trade the Helm to a neutral scholar of Daedric antiquities: removes the relic from Cyrodiil's war entirely, depriving both Traven and Mannimarco of its power.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_NECROMANCERS_AMULET: Caranya has taken the Necromancer's Amulet to Fort Ontus, plotting to defect to Mannimarco. (A) Confront and execute Caranya when she reveals her treason, returning the amulet to the University: eliminates a high-ranking traitor and seals Traven's defense perimeter. (B) Agree to hear Caranya's argument regarding Traven's dogmatic suppression of magical evolution: gains deeper philosophical understanding of the schism before making your choice. (C) Keep the Necromancer's Amulet equipped during battle: leverages its massive willpower and intelligence buffs to obliterate the fort's cultists.
Q_OBLIVION_ULTERIOR_MOTIVES: Traven sends you to retrieve a book from Count Janus Hassildor in Skingrad, unaware of the Count's secret motives. (A) Deliver Traven's request and uncover that the Council is using you as an unwitting spy against the Count: navigates courtly intrigue without provoking Hassildor's anger. (B) Slay the ambushers sent by the Necromancer cult outside Skingrad: proves your worth as the Council's elite enforcer and earns Hassildor's respect. (C) Agree to act as a double-agent between Hassildor and Traven: balances imperial guild interests against the independent autonomy of County Skingrad.
Q_OBLIVION_VAHTACENS_SECRET: An ancient Ayleid pillar in the ruin of Vahtacen repels spells with violent elemental backlash. (A) Decode the ancient Welkynd inscriptions and cast the four elemental spells in exact order: unlocks the secret chamber peacefully and retrieves the Ayleid helmet for Irlav Jarol. (B) Use brute-force magical warding to withstand the pillar's backlashes: forces your way through the arcane barrier through sheer resilience, bypassing the intellectual puzzle. (C) Loot the untouched Welkynd stones and Ayleid artifacts for personal research: plunders the excavation site before handing over the mission objective.
Q_OBLIVION_A_RAT_PROBLEM: Arvena Thelas in Anvil complains that mountain lions are infiltrating her basement and killing her pet rats. (A) Stake out the basement, track the lions to Quill-Weave's yard, and uncover her rotten meat bait: exposes Quill-Weave's petty feud peacefully while saving Arvena's surviving rats. (B) Slay Quill-Weave on the spot for endangering domestic residents: enforces brutal mercenary justice but shocks the Anvil community. (C) Extort hush money from Quill-Weave while claiming the full bounty from Arvena: maximizes personal coin from both sides of the domestic squabble.
Q_OBLIVION_AMELIONS_DEBT: Biene Amelion in Water's Edge owes 1,000 gold to lenders and asks you to recover her father's ancestral armor from a tomb. (A) Clear Amelion Tomb and retrieve the ancestral cuirass and longsword: satisfies the debt with physical relics, though Biene loses her family heirloom. (B) Pay Biene's 1,000 gold debt out of your own pocket and keep the Brusef Amelion armor: saves her family legacy while acquiring a museum-grade silver armor set. (C) Sell the ancestral armor to an underworld fence: leaves Biene destitute and on the run from collection thugs in Leyawiin.
Q_OBLIVION_AZANI_BLACKHEART_QUEST: Modryn Oreyn secretly enlists you to uncover what truly happened to Maglir and Vilena Donton's son against Azani Blackheart. (A) Infiltrate Arpenia and Atatar with Modryn, slay the warlord Blackheart, and recover his ring: proves the Blackwood Company took false credit and solidifies Modryn's partnership. (B) Keep Azani Blackheart's ring as personal war trophy: denies Modryn physical proof of the conspiracy in exchange for high-tier elven enchantment. (C) Expose Modryn's unsanctioned investigation to Vilena Donton: protects guild bureaucratic hierarchy at the cost of Modryn being stripped of his commission.
Q_OBLIVION_DEN_OF_THIEVES: A gang of thieves is terrorizing Anvil, and Azzan pairs you with the disgruntled, unreliable Maglir to track them down. (A) Sweep Hrota Cave, eliminate the thief ring, and cover for Maglir's cowardice in your report: maintains guild cohesion and secures Azzan's respect. (B) Report Maglir's laziness and failure to engage directly to Azzan: initiates the disciplinary disciplinary spiral that drives Maglir into the Blackwood Company. (C) Cut a secret deal with the thieves' leader: takes a portion of their stolen plunder to steer guild patrols away from Hrota Cave.
Q_OBLIVION_DRUNK_AND_DISORDERLY: Three drunken guild members are brawling and terrorizing Leyawiin's Five Claws Lodge due to lack of employment. (A) Negotiate a contract with Margarte to hire the trio as ogre tooth and minotaur horn suppliers: restores order in Leyawiin and provides the fighters with honorable, productive labor. (B) Beat the unruly guild members unconscious in tavern combat: proves physical dominance through brawn, intimidating them into quiet obedience. (C) Frame the Blackwood Company for inciting the tavern riot: sparks citywide street violence between the rival mercenary guilds.
Q_OBLIVION_EXPELLED_FROM_THE_FIGHTERS_GU: Having committed murder or theft against guild members, you must deliver 20 bear pelts to prove contrition. (A) Hunt 20 wild brown bears across the Great Forest through grueling tracking: proves martial dedication and physical penance to the Guildmaster. (B) Buy pelts from local hunters and furriers: uses commercial shortcuts to restore guild rank without shedding sweat in the wilds. (C) Raid a local hunting camp and seize their winter pelt caches by force: reinforces your ruthless mercenary reputation while meeting the reinstatement quota.
Q_OBLIVION_INFILTRATION: Modryn Oreyn orders you to infiltrate the Blackwood Company's Leyawiin headquarters to discover the secret of their combat prowess. (A) Enlist as a recruit, consume their psychoactive Hist sap concoction, and witness the hallucinatory frenzy: uncovers the horrific source of their combat rage. (B) Steal the recipe and ledger from Ja'Fazir's desk without drinking the sap: avoids mental contamination while bringing documentary proof back to Modryn. (C) Embrace the Hist sap's feral strength: channels the ancient Argonian battle frenzy to slaughter Blackwood instructors from within.
Q_OBLIVION_INFORMATION_GATHERING: Modryn Oreyn captures Ajum-Kaji, a Blackwood Company leader, and needs him interrogated regarding their leadership structure. (A) Interrogate Ajum-Kaji using verbal intimidation and magical threats: extracts details about Ri'Zakar and the Hist before Ajum-Kaji swallows lethal Blackwood poison. (B) Hand Ajum-Kaji over to the Leyawiin Imperial Guard: avoids illicit interrogation torture, but allows the Blackwood Company to bribe guards for his release. (C) Offer Ajum-Kaji asylum in Morrowind in exchange for the Hist extraction blueprint: seeks a bloodless resolution before his fanatical suicide.
Q_OBLIVION_MORE_UNFINISHED_BUSINESS: Maglir has defaulted on another contract in Bravil, refusing to retrieve a magical staff for Aryarie. (A) Travel to Bramblepoint Cave, retrieve the Staff of Indarys, and give Maglir the credit: covers for your comrade one last time out of loyalty. (B) Return the staff to Aryarie and report Maglir's outright breach of duty to Modryn: results in Maglir's dishonorable expulsion, paving his defection. (C) Keep the Staff of Indarys for its devastating shock enchantment: forfeits the guild fee in exchange for an ancient royal weapon of House Indarys.
Q_OBLIVION_MYSTERY_AT_HARLUNS_WATCH: Villagers at Harlun's Watch are disappearing into the swamps, lured by mysterious glowing will-o-the-wisps into Swampy Cave. (A) Slay the swamp trolls and will-o-the-wisps, recovering the corpses of the townsfolk: brings somber closure to Drarana Hurm and the grieving hamlet. (B) Burn the entire Swampy Cave complex with wildfire oil: eradicates the troll brood permanently, preventing any further swamp casualties. (C) Harvest the rare wisp wrappings and troll fat for the alchemy trade: prioritizes lucrative ingredient collection over the villagers' rescue.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_DESOLATE_MINE: Goblins have infested Desolate Mine near Cheydinhal, threatening local miners and supply routes. (A) Equip the greenhorn guild recruits with specialized weapons and lead an organized assault: clears the mine with zero guild casualties and earns Burz gro-Khash's praise. (B) Charge the goblin chieftains alone, leaving the recruits in reserve: claims the glory and combat experience single-handedly, but damages team morale. (C) Collapse the mine entrance with explosive spells: seals the goblins inside forever, but ruins the iron mine's economic viability for Cheydinhal.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_FUGITIVES: Four escaped convicts from the Imperial Prison have holed up in Bloodrun Cave, threatening Bravil's trade. (A) Storm Bloodrun Cave and execute all four fugitives with methodical martial precision: completes the contract and cleanses the Bravil perimeter. (B) Offer the fugitives passage to Elsweyr in exchange for their hidden loot: takes a bribe and spares former prisoners, defying Burz gro-Khash's orders. (C) Infiltrate the cave and assassinate their leader Ennodius silently: breaks the gang's morale, forcing the remaining bandits to surrender to the town guard.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_HIST: Having uncovered the Blackwood Company's secret, you must destroy the corrupted Hist tree in their Leyawiin basement. (A) Sabotage the Hist tree's pumping machinery and slay Ri'Zakar: destroys the corrupted tree, dissolves the Blackwood Company, and avenges Water's Edge. (B) Preserve a clipping of the corrupted Hist root for alchemical study: risks spreading the unnatural sap in exchange for unparalleled biological enhancement. (C) Challenge Ri'Zakar to an honorable warrior duel in his office: settles the guild war with martial dignity before torching the laboratory.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_MASTERS_SON: Vilena Donton's son Viranus is sent on an easy assignment to Nonwyll Cavern to build confidence, but dangers lurk within. (A) Protect Viranus diligently through the cavern and recover Galtus Previa's shield: builds the boy's confidence while keeping him alive for his mother. (B) Let Viranus fight the savage trolls himself: tests the Guildmaster's son in real blood and steel, risking fatal injuries. (C) Escort Viranus back to Chorrol immediately upon sensing a Blackwood ambush: prioritizes the boy's safety over the retrieval mission.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_NOBLES_DAUGHTER: Rugdumph gro-Shurgak's daughter Lady Rogbut has been kidnapped by wild ogres near his estate. (A) Track the ogres, slay their clan, and escort Lady Rogbut safely back to Lord Rugdumph: earns the unique enchanted claymore 'Rugdumph's Sword'. (B) Negotiate with the ogre leader using beast-tongue or illusion: resolves the kidnapping without combat, confounding the haughty Orc noble. (C) Extort Lord Rugdumph for a doubled rescue fee: exploits the nobleman's pomposity for extra gold, souring relations with Burz gro-Khash.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_STONE_OF_ST_ALESSIA: Ogres have raided the Chapel of Talos in Bruma and stolen the sacred Stone of St. Alessia. (A) Track the ogre raiders to Sedor, recover the holy stone, and return it to Cirroc: restores holy blessings to Bruma and bolsters Imperial faith. (B) Channel the stone's sacred Alessian divine energy to permanently bless your party: claims ancient saintly resilience at the cost of sacrilegious chapel theft. (C) Ransom the relic back to the Elder Council: forces imperial bureaucrats to pay exorbitant sums for their own historical heritage.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_UNFORTUNATE_SHOPKEEPER: Norbert Lelles's shop in Anvil is repeatedly ransacked at night by mysterious burglars. (A) Stake out Lelles Quality Merchandise, catch the three burglar sailors red-handed, and slay them: secures the shop and earns Norbert's eternal gratitude and gold. (B) Interrogate the burglars to uncover their smuggling ring: traces the stolen goods back to a wider pirate syndicate operating out of the Anvil docks. (C) Rob Norbert's shop yourself after slaying the burglars: takes advantage of the chaos to clean out his rarest imported inventory.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_WANDERING_SCHOLAR: Elante of Alinor is exploring Brittlerock Cave to study Daedric cultism and requires an armed escort. (A) Escort Elante safely through the Daedra-infested tunnels and protect her during her research: completes the contract flawlessly and earns an enchanted blade. (B) Use Elante as living bait to flush out high-tier Daedric scamps and dremora: maximizes combat loot and Daedric hearts at extreme risk to the scholar's life. (C) Steal Elante's research notes on Daedric summoning: gains forbidden knowledge of Oblivion gateways before guiding her back to the road.
Q_OBLIVION_TROLLS_OF_FORSAKEN_MINE: A Fighters Guild squad led by Viranus Donton was sent into Forsaken Mine and has fallen silent. (A) Enter Forsaken Mine, discover the butchered guild members and Viranus's corpse, and avenge them against the savage trolls: recovers Viranus's bloody journal exposing the Blackwood Company. (B) Incinerate the entire mine with Greek fire: wipes out the mutated trolls to prevent their spread toward Leyawiin, burning the bodies with honor. (C) Confront the Blackwood mercenaries lingering outside the mine: attacks the assassins responsible directly, initiating open war.
Q_OBLIVION_UNFINISHED_BUSINESS: Maglir has abandoned his guild contract to find a debt ledger in Fallen Rock Cave out of cowardice. (A) Clear the undead from Fallen Rock Cave, retrieve Brenus Astis's journal, and gently counsel Maglir: earns Modryn's approval while helping a struggling comrade. (B) Berate Maglir publicly for abandoning his sworn oath: establishes uncompromising discipline, driving Maglir toward resentment. (C) Burn the debt ledger inside the cave: wipes out the client's financial records, freeing local debtors from predatory interest.
Q_OBLIVION_AHDARJIS_HEIRLOOM: Ahdarji's ancestral ring was stolen by Amusei and ended up in the private jewelry box of the Countess of Leyawiin. (A) Infiltrate Castle Leyawiin's secret torture chambers, slip into the Countess's bedchamber while she sleeps, and retrieve the ring: preserves strict guild pacifism and earns double bounty from S'Krivva. (B) Expose the Countess's secret torture dungeon to the Imperial Legion: damages County Leyawiin's political standing while retrieving the ring amid the scandal. (C) Keep the ring for its powerful sneak and illusion enchantments: leaves Ahdarji brokenhearted while acquiring a master-tier rogue ring.
Q_OBLIVION_ARROW_OF_EXTRICATION: The Gray Fox needs the key-shaped Arrow of Extrication, kept by the court wizard Fathis Aren in Bravil. (A) Infiltrate Fathis Aren's tower through the flooded grotto and steal the Arrowhead without slaying the wizard: upholds the Gray Fox's bloodless oath and claims a key piece of the grand heist. (B) Slay Fathis Aren in his personal sanctum: triggers a heavy Thieves Guild blood price but eliminates a dangerous Altmer conjurer. (C) Trade Aren a counterfeit arrow crafted by an Imperial City smith: deceives the court wizard while escaping with the authentic relic.
Q_OBLIVION_BOOTS_OF_SPRINGHEEL_JAK: The legendary Boots of Springheel Jak are owned by Jakben, Earl of Imbel, who is secretly a vampire noble. (A) Confront Jakben in his ancestral crypt, slay him in self-defense when he reveals his vampiric fangs, and take the boots: secures the boots for the Gray Fox without violating guild rules. (B) Bribe Jakben with fresh mortal thralls: trades innocent blood for the boots, avoiding combat while descending into criminal depravity. (C) Expose Jakben's vampiric identity to the Imperial Watch: lets the guards storm Imbel Manor while you snatch the boots during the raid.
Q_OBLIVION_CAST_OUT_OF_THE_THIEVES_GUILD: Having broken the Thieves Guild rules by killing on a job or stealing from brothers, you must pay a heavy blood price. (A) Pay Armand Christophe or S'Krivva the full gold fine: demonstrates wealth and contrition, cleanly wiping away your disciplinary suspension. (B) Frame a rival cutpurse for your violations: shifts the blame to an innocent waterfront thief, cheating the guild's restorative justice. (C) Defy the guild council and operate as an outlaw rogue: forfeits guild fences and protection in exchange for absolute criminal independence.
Q_OBLIVION_FINDING_THE_THIEVES_GUILD: You seek to make contact with the elusive Thieves Guild in the Imperial City Waterfront. (A) Bribe local Waterfront beggars to reveal the midnight gathering at the Garden of Dareloth: earns the trust of the city's underclass and opens the door to Armand Christophe. (B) Read a 'Wanted: The Gray Fox' poster and speak to an impoverished resident: tracks down the meeting through sharp observation and social sympathy. (C) Steal the private ledger of Captain Hieronymus Lex: presents imperial security secrets as your calling card to Armand.
Q_OBLIVION_INDEPENDENT_THIEVERY: To advance through guild ranks, you must fence escalating amounts of stolen plunder to underworld fences. (A) Target opulent noble manors in the Elven Gardens and Talos Plaza: fences high-value jewels and silverware without harming common folk. (B) Plunder provincial shops and rural trading posts: builds fencing totals quickly through bulk goods, straining provincial economies. (C) Fence stolen Church silver and chapel relics: earns rapid gold while incurring the spiritual ire of the Nine Divines.
Q_OBLIVION_LOST_HISTORIES: The Gray Fox needs a mysterious book titled 'Lost Histories of Tamriel', but thief Theranis was captured in Skingrad. (A) Infiltrate Skingrad's dungeons, follow the Pale Lady's blood trail, and recover the book from the well: completes the heist and avenges Theranis without alerting Castle guards. (B) Slay the vampiric Pale Lady in her feeding cell: purges a horrific castle predator while securing the book, but risks raising the castle alarm. (C) Ransom the ancient tome to Count Janus Hassildor: trades the book's historical secrets for aristocratic immunity in Skingrad.
Q_OBLIVION_MAY_THE_BEST_THIEF_WIN: Armand Christophe challenges you, Methredhel, and Amusei to steal Rohssan's antique cutlass from the Imperial City. (A) Pick Rohssan's lock and steal the cutlass before Methredhel reaches it: wins the trial cleanly through superior speed and stealth. (B) Allow Methredhel to steal the sword, then pickpocket it from her chest in the Waterfront: outsmarts your rival thief, earning Armand's chuckling admiration. (C) Bribe Rohssan directly to hand over the cutlass: bypasses the burglary trial with merchant coin, raising questions about your roguish purism.
Q_OBLIVION_MISDIRECTION: Hieronymus Lex has occupied the Waterfront with heavy watchmen, halting all illicit trade. (A) Steal Arch-Mage Traven's staff from the Arcane University and plant a note from the Gray Fox: provokes the Council to force Lex's guards back to the University, freeing the Waterfront. (B) Slip into the Imperial City barracks and steal the Watch's payroll: humiliates Lex financially while funding waterfront relief. (C) Provoke an armed riot among the waterfront dockworkers: forces the Legion to intervene against Lex's heavy-handed occupation, risking peasant bloodshed.
Q_OBLIVION_TAKING_CARE_OF_LEX: The Gray Fox wants Captain Hieronymus Lex permanently reassigned to Castle Anvil to protect the Waterfront forever. (A) Forge a letter of recommendation using the Imperial Legion seal and bribe Countess Umbranox's secretary: reassigns Lex to Anvil honorably, permanently neutralizing his threat. (B) Slay Lex in a dark alley: removes the captain permanently but breaks the guild's sacred pacifist creed. (C) Frame Lex for embezzlement using forged Watch ledgers: destroys Lex's military career and lands him in the Imperial Dungeon.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_ELVEN_MAIDEN: Armand Christophe assigns you to steal the bust of Llathasa Indarys from the Cheydinhal royal crypt. (A) Infiltrate the crypt silently, snatch the bust, and discover the bust was a setup by the traitor Myvryna Arano: exposes the informant to Lex and saves Armand. (B) Plant the bust in Myvryna's cupboard and lead Lex straight to her: turns Lex's own zeal against his spy, cementing Armand's freedom. (C) Smash the bust in the crypt and warn Myvryna to flee Cyrodiil: spares the informant's life while abandoning the assignment, angering the guild.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_ULTIMATE_HEIST: The Gray Fox leads the heist of the era: infiltrate the Imperial Palace via the Old Way and steal an Elder Scroll. (A) Navigate the glass sewers, fire the Arrow of Extrication, slip past the Blind Moth Priests, and escape with the Elder Scroll: breaks Corvus Umbranox's curse and crowns you the new Gray Fox. (B) Slay the Blind Moth Priests to seize their ancient divine texts: accelerates the escape at the cost of massacring holy blind monks. (C) Read the Elder Scroll during your escape: glimpses cosmic truth about the Aurbis at the cost of permanent ocular strain and mental vertigo.
Q_OBLIVION_TURNING_A_BLIND_EYE: The Gray Fox needs the mystical Savilla's Stone, guarded by the blind monks of the Temple of the Ancestor Moths. (A) Infiltrate the subterranean catacombs silently and take Savilla's Stone without harming a single blind priest: upholds guild honor and secures the divinatory crystal. (B) Defeat the aggressive Temple guardians in open combat: clears a path to the stone quickly, though the screams echo across the Jerall Mountains. (C) Steal the Ancestor Moths' silk harvesting secrets alongside the stone: provides high-value textile trade secrets to Waterfront weavers.
Q_OBLIVION_UNTAXING_THE_POOR: Hieronymus Lex has seized the harsh waterfront taxes from impoverished shantytown residents. (A) Infiltrate Lex's South Watchtower quarters, steal the tax records, and return the gold to Armand: brings immediate relief to the poorest district and humiliates the Watch. (B) Replace the tax records with forged documents showing the waterfront is fully exempt: establishes long-term legal protection for the poor. (C) Keep the confiscated waterfront taxes for yourself: amasses easy early coin at the expense of destitute dockworkers.
Q_OBLIVION_ALLIES_FOR_BRUMA: Jauffre asks you to rally garrison reinforcements from every Cyrodiil county to defend Bruma from the Great Gate. (A) Close the Oblivion Gates threatening all seven county capitals to secure full legions of aid: forges an unprecedented united provincial coalition for the battle of Bruma. (B) Focus on securing only the wealthiest counties (Imperial City, Skingrad, Cheydinhal): minimizes travel time and concentrates heavy elite armor, but leaves southern borders vulnerable. (C) Demand that counts send troops unconditionally under Imperial emergency decree: bullies provincial nobility, securing soldiers at the cost of deep regional resentment.
Q_OBLIVION_BLOOD_OF_THE_DAEDRA: Martin Septim requires the blood of a Daedric Prince—contained in an authentic Daedric artifact—to open Mankar Camoran's portal. (A) Offer Azura's Star, Wabbajack, or the Skull of Corruption on the ritual anvil: destroys a wondrous metaphysical relic to advance the salvation of Tamriel. (B) Seek out the most malevolent artifact (Mehrunes' Razor or Ebony Blade) to destroy dark evil: purges a cursed relic from the mortal plane while empowering the Septim ritual. (C) Hesitate to sacrifice the relic and seek an alternative conduit: buys time to experiment with lesser Daedric hearts, delaying Martin's portal preparation.
Q_OBLIVION_BLOOD_OF_THE_DIVINES: Martin needs the dried blood of a Divine, found on the ancient Armor of Tiber Septim inside Sancre Tor. (A) Enter the haunted catacombs of Sancre Tor, free the four cursed Blade ghosts, and retrieve the holy armor: cleanses an ancient imperial tomb and earns the blessings of the Nine. (B) Absorb the divine essence lingering on the armor into your own blood: gains divine physical constitution before delivering the relic to Martin. (C) Plunder the catacombs of the Reman emperors alongside the armor: recovers priceless First Era imperial regalia, risking ancient ghostly curses.
Q_OBLIVION_BREAKING_THE_SIEGE_OF_KVATCH: Kvatch is engulfed in Daedric hellfire, and Savlian Matius needs a champion to enter the colossal Oblivion Gate. (A) Charge through the gate, climb the Sigil Keep, and sever the Sigil Stone from its magma cradle: collapses the gate, saves Kvatch survivors, and earns the title 'Hero of Kvatch'. (B) Rally the city guards into a defensive perimeter outside while you breach the gate alone: minimizes mortal casualties at the cost of facing Dremora lords in solo combat. (C) Loot the Daedric spires for rare Sigil Stones and dark armor before closing the portal: amasses incredible magical wealth while Kvatch's Chapel of Akatosh hangs by a thread.
Q_OBLIVION_BRUMA_GATE: A standard Oblivion Gate opens outside Bruma, and Captain Burd's guards must be trained to close it. (A) Escort Captain Burd through the fiery plane of Oblivion, teaching him how to disrupt the Sigil Keep: transforms Bruma's town guard into disciplined, fearless Daedra hunters. (B) Clear the Dremora hordes yourself and let Burd claim the victory: boosts city morale and political confidence in Burd's command at the expense of true combat readiness. (C) Intentionally leave the gate open temporarily to study Daedric troop movements: gathers crucial tactical intelligence for Jauffre, risking a surprise Daedric sortie.
Q_OBLIVION_DAGON_SHRINE: Infiltrate the Mythic Dawn's secret subterranean cavern in Lake Arrius to steal the Mysterium Xarxes. (A) Play along with Harrow, don the cult robes, and rescue the sacrificial captive Jeelius while seizing the Mysterium Xarxes: deals a devastating blow to Mankar Camoran and saves an innocent. (B) Execute the Argonian sacrifice on Dagon's altar to cement your deep cover: allows you to walk out with the holy book unchallenged, but stains your hands with innocent blood. (C) Slay Harrow and charge into the temple with unsheathed steel: slaughters the entire Mythic Dawn coven in a blazing bloodbath, collapsing the cavern roof.
Q_OBLIVION_DEFENSE_OF_BRUMA: Martin Septim commands the defense outside Bruma, allowing three lesser gates to open so the Great Gate can emerge. (A) Guard Martin Septim with your life against waves of Daedra until the Great Gate manifests: preserves the royal bloodline and anchors the frontline through sheer martial heroism. (B) Use tactical choke points to funnel Daedric siege engines away from Martin: optimizes battlefield survivability for allied county soldiers. (C) Channel mass destruction magic across the battlefield: wipes out Daedric shock troops instantly, risking friendly fire among allied soldiers.
Q_OBLIVION_DELIVER_THE_AMULET: Following Emperor Uriel Septim VII's assassination, you must deliver the Amulet of Kings to Jauffre at Weynon Priory. (A) Travel swiftly across the Great Forest and deliver the Amulet directly into Jauffre's hands: secures the imperial heirloom and alerts the Grandmaster of the Blades without delay. (B) Seek audience with High Chancellor Ocato in the Imperial Palace first: informs the Elder Council of the Emperor's demise, navigating imperial political panic. (C) Attempt to wear the Amulet of Kings yourself: confirms that non-Dragonborn cannot wear the relic, reinforcing the divine prophecy.
Q_OBLIVION_FIND_THE_HEIR: Jauffre reveals that Uriel Septim's illegitimate son, Brother Martin, is a humble priest in the besieged city of Kvatch. (A) Brave the smoking ruins of Kvatch, find Martin sheltering survivors in the Chapel of Akatosh, and persuade him of his heritage: brings the reluctant heir under Blades protection. (B) Convince Martin to leave the Chapel immediately before clearing the city: prioritizes royal extraction, leaving Kvatch refugees to fend for themselves. (C) Reveal the Emperor's dying words to Martin in the chapel: helps Martin accept his overwhelming destiny through honest emotional counsel.
Q_OBLIVION_GREAT_GATE: The colossal Great Gate has opened at Bruma, and a massive Daedric Siege Crawler threatens to crush the city in 15 minutes. (A) Race through the sprawling fiery citadels of Oblivion, reach the Sigil Tower apex, and extract the Great Sigil Stone just in time: destroys the Siege Crawler and saves Bruma from annihilation. (B) Stop to systematically destroy the Daedric support generators inside the gate: weakens the gateway permanently, but cuts the timer dangerously close. (C) Claim the Great Sigil Stone and channel its cosmic power into your own equipment: unlocks supreme enchanting potential before sealing the gate.
Q_OBLIVION_IMPERIAL_DRAGON_ARMOR: Following Martin's sacrifice, High Chancellor Ocato orders the Imperial Armorer to forge your legendary Imperial Dragon Armor. (A) Commission the classical heavy Imperial Dragon Cuirass: symbolizes unbreakable martial loyalty to the Empire and crowns you Champion of Cyrodiil. (B) Request a customized lightweight variant optimized for stealth and skirmishing: adapts imperial regalia for a shadow operative rather than a front-line soldier. (C) Dedicate the ceremonial armor to Martin Septim's memory in the Temple of the One: inspires a wave of religious and imperial reverence across all nine counties.
Q_OBLIVION_LIGHT_THE_DRAGONFIRES: Escort Martin Septim to the Temple of the One as Mehrunes Dagon himself manifests in colossal form within the Imperial City. (A) Fight your way to the Temple of the One, allowing Martin to shatter the Amulet of Kings and become the Avatar of Akatosh: banishes Mehrunes Dagon and seals Oblivion forever at the cost of Martin's mortal life. (B) Engage Mehrunes Dagon directly in the courtyard to buy Martin critical seconds: tests mortal steel against the Lord of Destruction himself before retreating into the temple. (C) Urge Martin to search for an alternative ritual: risks the total destruction of Tamriel in a desperate attempt to save Martin's life.
Q_OBLIVION_MISCARCAND_QUEST: Martin requires a Great Welkynd Stone from the ancient, treacherous Ayleid capital of Miscarcand. (A) Infiltrate Miscarcand's subterranean halls, defeat the Lich King of Miscarcand, and secure the Great Welkynd Stone: provides the core power source for Martin's ritual portal. (B) Use Welkynd resonance magic to dismantle the ruin's traps from a distance: clears the ancient capital methodically without awakening dormant undead guardians. (C) Loot the tombs of ancient Ayleid sorcerer-kings alongside the stone: claims First Era magical treasures, provoking the wrath of ancient elven spirits.
Q_OBLIVION_PARADISE_QUEST: Enter Mankar Camoran's alternate dimension of Gaiar Alata (Paradise) to reclaim the stolen Amulet of Kings. (A) Battle through the Savage Garden, confront Mankar Camoran in his Carac Agaialor throne room, and slay him: destroys Paradise and recovers the Amulet of Kings for Martin. (B) Debate Mankar Camoran on the metaphysical nature of Tamriel as a realm of Oblivion: challenges Camoran's theology before delivering righteous judgment. (C) Spare Camoran's children, Raven and Ruma, while striking down the father: attempts to break the Camoran dynasty's cycle of fanaticism.
Q_OBLIVION_SPIES: Mythic Dawn sleeper agents Jearl and Saveri Faram are spying on Cloud Ruler Temple from Bruma. (A) Stake out Jearl's house in Bruma, uncover the subterranean tunnel, and eliminate both spies: intercepts attack plans for Bruma and protects Cloud Ruler Temple's secrecy. (B) Interrogate Jearl before slaying her: extracts details about the hidden Oblivion Gate planned for Bruma before turning her plans over to Jauffre. (C) Allow the spies to report false information regarding Martin's defenses: misleads the Mythic Dawn command, setting an ambush for their vanguard.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_BATTLE_FOR_CASTLE_KVATCH: Savlian Matius launches a counterattack to reclaim Castle Kvatch and find Count Ormellius Goldwine. (A) Breach Castle Kvatch with Matius, fight through the blazing courtyard, and discover the fallen Count: secures the Count's signet ring and drives the Daedra from Kvatch. (B) Search the royal vaults while Savlian fights the Dremora in the throne room: retrieves ancient Colovian treasures before reporting the Count's tragic demise. (C) Offer Savlian Matius emotional counsel as he mourns his fallen comrades: helps the surviving captain shoulder the burden of ruling a ruined city.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_PATH_OF_DAWN: Track down the four volumes of Commentaries on the Mysterium Xarxes with Baurus to find the Mythic Dawn's lair. (A) Stake out the sunken sewers with Baurus, ambush the cult's sponsor, and decode the celestial map at Green Emperor Way: reveals Lake Arrius cleanly without losing Baurus. (B) Let Baurus handle the meeting alone while covering him with a bow: risks Baurus's life in close-quarters combat while watching for cloaked assassins. (C) Study the four volumes deeply yourself with Phintias: deciphers the esoteric Dawn mysticism, gaining permanent insight into Daedric metaphysics.
Q_OBLIVION_TUTORIAL: Escape the Imperial Prison dungeons with Emperor Uriel Septim VII and the Blades through secret subterranean escape routes. (A) Guard Emperor Uriel Septim to his final breath, receiving the Amulet of Kings and his dying charge: sets your hero's destiny into motion with sacred duty. (B) Pick the locks and explore every forgotten cell and goblin cavern along the sewer route: gathers critical starting lockpicks, spells, and gear before reaching the surface. (C) Question the Emperor regarding his prophetic dreams of your face: delves into the mysteries of predestination and mortal will before the assassin strikes.
Q_OBLIVION_WEYNON_PRIORY_QUEST: Return to Weynon Priory after closing the Kvatch gate to find it under siege by Mythic Dawn assassins. (A) Slay the assassins besieging the chapel, rescue Prior Maborel's dying words, and protect Jauffre: confirms the theft of the Amulet of Kings and retreats to Cloud Ruler Temple. (B) Charge into the monastery stables to save the prize horses: preserves mobility and travel assets for the Blades at the cost of chapel defense. (C) Pursue the fleeing cultists carrying the Amulet: attempts an immediate desperate pursuit into the Great Forest before they reach Camoran.
Q_OBLIVION_AZURA: Azura tasks you with granting merciful death to five of her followers who contracted vampirism in Gutted Mine. (A) Slay the five tragic vampires and place Azura's glowing rose at the altar: frees their souls from torment and receives Azura's Star, the infinite grand soul gem. (B) Seek an experimental cure for vampirism to save Azura's followers: defies the Prince's death sentence in a bid for redemption, risking Azura's wrath. (C) Trap the souls of the five vampires in standard black soul gems: exploits their tragic suffering for personal necromantic power, permanently desecrating Azura's shrine.
Q_OBLIVION_BOETHIA: Boethiah demands you enter the Tournament of Ten Bloods in Oblivion and slaughter champions of all ten mortal races. (A) Defeat all nine racial champions in bloody arena combat: proves supreme martial dominance and claims the legendary Goldbrand katana. (B) Form a tactical pact with one of the champions to fight through the arena together: challenges Boethiah's creed of selfish slaughter before a final unavoidable duel. (C) Refuse to strike down unarmed or wounded contestants: defies the Prince of Plots, proving mortal virtue over bloodsport at the cost of forfeiting the artifact.
Q_OBLIVION_CLAVICUS_VILE: Clavicus Vile wants the soul-stealing sword Umbra, but his hound Barbas begs you not to deliver it. (A) Slay Umbra in Vindasel and return the cursed sword to Clavicus Vile: receives the Masque of Clavicus Vile and restores the Prince's full power. (B) Heed Barbas's desperate warning, keep the sword Umbra, and walk away: retains Tamriel's deadliest soul-trapping longsword while spurning the Prince of Bargains. (C) Redeem Lenwin (Umbra) by using restoration magic to break the sword's psychic grip: frees the warrior's soul from the blade's curse.
Q_OBLIVION_HERMAEUS_MORA: Hermaeus Mora demands one soul of each of the ten mortal races using his specialized soul-trapping spell. (A) Harvest the ten racial souls from marauders and bandits across Cyrodiil: earns the Oghma Infinium, unlocking permanent god-tier attribute boosts. (B) Harvest the souls from loyal provincial guildmates: accelerates the ritual through ruthless pragmatism, corrupting your conscience forever. (C) Cleanse Hermaeus Mora's soul-trap spell with divine blessing: studies the Prince of Knowledge's magic without shedding mortal blood, though the tome remains sealed.
Q_OBLIVION_HIRCINE: Hircine demands the horn of a majestic unicorn that grazes in Harcane Grove guarded by minotaurs. (A) Slay the mythical unicorn and present its horn upon Hircine's altar: earns the Savior's Hide, an armor of immense magic resistance. (B) Tame and ride the unicorn as your loyal mount across Cyrodiil: refuses to butcher an innocent legendary beast, defying the Lord of the Hunt. (C) Slay the minotaur guardians and protect the unicorn from other hunters: preserves the grove's sacred sanctuary against imperial poachers.
Q_OBLIVION_MALACATH: Malacath is enraged that Lord Drad has enslaved ogres in his private mines near Anvil. (A) Infiltrate Lord Drad's estate, unlock the subterranean cages, and free the ogres: earns Volendrung, the mighty paralyzing warhammer of the Pariah. (B) Force Lord Drad and his wife to work the mines under ogre overseers: delivers ironic, humiliating justice to the abusive slaver aristocracy. (C) Slay both Drad and the ogres: wipes out the entire operation in a storm of steel, pleasing neither faction.
Q_OBLIVION_MEPHALA: Mephala commands you to incite a bloody civil war between the peaceful Nord and Dunmer families of Bleaker's Way. (A) Murder Dalvilu and Ulfgar, plant false evidence on their bodies, and watch the families slaughter each other: earns the Ebony Blade, Mephala's life-draining katana. (B) Expose Mephala's conspiracy to both Hrol Ulfgar and Nisa Dalvilu: unites the village against Daedric manipulation, preserving Bleaker's Way at the cost of the blade. (C) Assassinate only the family patriarchs and claim the entire village as your personal fiefdom: exploits the turmoil for political control.
Q_OBLIVION_MERIDIA: Meridia despises the undead and tasks you with cleansing a nest of necromancers in Howling Cave. (A) Purge the necromancers and their skeletal thralls from Howling Cave: earns the Ring of the Khajiiti, granting supreme chameleon and speed enchantments. (B) Capture the necromancers' research on lingering spirits: studies their dark craft before putting them to the sword, testing Meridia's patience. (C) Turn the necromancers' undead minions against their masters: executes ironic justice before sanctifying the cavern.
Q_OBLIVION_MOLAG_BAL: Molag Bal demands you force the pacifist knight Melus Petilius to beat you to death with a cursed mace at his wife's grave. (A) Goad Melus Petilius into an uncontrollable rage until he bludgeons your comatose body with the cursed mace: earns the Mace of Molag Bal, the dreaded drain-magicka weapon. (B) Refuse to provoke Petilius, honoring his vow of pacifism and grief: defies the Lord of Domination and preserves a broken knight's redemption. (C) Provoke Petilius, but disarm and subdue him before he strikes: proves that mortal will can resist Daedric compulsion.
Q_OBLIVION_NAMIRA: Namira commands you to cast a spell of darkness upon priests of Arkay illuminating the wretched Anga ruins. (A) Cast the spell on the priests, allowing Namira's grotesque Forgotten Ones to devour them: earns the Ring of Namira, reflecting damage and spells back at attackers. (B) Warn the priests of Arkay of Namira's plot and evacuate them safely: preserves sacred light and human life, forfeiting the Prince of the Grotesque's favor. (C) Force the Forgotten Ones into the sunlight to confront civilized society: exposes the subterranean horrors of Anga to imperial authorities.
Q_OBLIVION_NOCTURNAL: Nocturnal's Eye was stolen by two Argonian thieves in Leyawiin and hidden in Tidewater Cave. (A) Eavesdrop on Weebam-Na and Bejeen, retrieve the Eye from the flooded troll cave, and return it: earns the Skeleton Key, the unbreakable lockpick. (B) Attempt to harness the mystical divinatory vision of Nocturnal's Eye yourself: gains cosmic sight at the risk of permanent blindness from the Mistress of Shadows. (C) Hand the Argonian thieves over to Count Leyawiin for public trial: enforces mortal law, though Nocturnal mocks your petty legalism.
Q_OBLIVION_PERYITE: Peryite's followers are trapped in a soul-frozen trance after attempting to summon the Taskmaster. (A) Travel into Peryite's desolate plane of Oblivion, rescue all five frozen souls, and guide them back: earns the Spell Breaker, the ultimate spell-reflecting shield. (B) Absorb the lingering soul energies of the frozen followers: claims forbidden Daedric endurance while leaving the cultists trapped forever. (C) Awaken the cultists and dismantle their summoning shrine: prevents future foolish summoning accidents in Cyrodiil's wilderness.
Q_OBLIVION_SANGUINE: Sanguine commands you to cast the 'Stark Reality' spell on Countess Alessia Caro's haughty dinner party in Castle Leyawiin. (A) Infiltrate the banquet, cast the spell to strip every noble completely naked, and flee the guards: earns the staff of the Sanguine Rose from the Prince of Hedonism. (B) Cast the spell on the city guards outside instead: turns the city watch into an embarrassing spectacle while sparing the diplomatic banquet. (C) Spike the banquet punch bowl with enchanted vintage wine: creates a roaring tavern-style revelry without stripping the nobility, finding a middle ground.
Q_OBLIVION_SHEOGORATH: Sheogorath wants you to terrorize the superstitious Khajiit village of Border Watch by fulfilling three apocalyptic omens. (A) Steal the Olroy cheese, summon the vermin, kill the livestock, and trigger the rain of burning dogs: delights the Madgod and earns the chaotic Wabbajack. (B) Warn Ri'Bassa that Sheogorath's omens are being artificially orchestrated: spares the village mental terror, though Sheogorath mocks your lack of imagination. (C) Exploit the mass hysteria to convince the Khajiit to relocate closer to Leyawiin: turns the supernatural prank into an economic migration.
Q_OBLIVION_VAERMINA: Vaermina demands the Black Soul Gem held by the wizard Arkved, whose nightmares have warped Arkved's Tower. (A) Navigate the surreal, upside-down dreamscapes of Arkved's Tower and retrieve the gem from the sleeping mage: earns the Skull of Corruption. (B) Wake Arkved from his endless nightmare and break Vaermina's torment: saves an afflicted sorcerer's sanity at the cost of the Daedric staff. (C) Plunder Arkved's warped architectural library for forbidden illusion secrets: acquires surreal mental spellcraft before delivering the gem.
Q_OBLIVION_ACROBATICS_TRAINING: Torbern at Aerin's Camp in the Jerall Mountains will only instruct true acrobats who prove their nimbleness. (A) Scale the sheer vertical cliffs and leap across the jagged glacial chasms of the Jeralls: impresses Torbern and unlocks master acrobatics, allowing water-jumping. (B) Use feather and levitation spells to simulate unnatural vertical leaps: earns the training through clever arcane trickery rather than physical conditioning. (C) Challenge Torbern to an acrobatic downhill race: tests your agility on treacherous scree slopes, risking fatal mountain falls.
Q_OBLIVION_ALCHEMY_TRAINING: Sinderion in the basement of the West Weald Inn demands you deliver an authentic bottle of Tamika 399 and Shadowbanish wine. (A) Source the vintage bottles from private collectors or ancient cellars and present them to Sinderion: earns master alchemy training and access to potent potion synthesis. (B) Craft a counterfeit vintage blend using rare berries and illusion alchemy: deceives the master alchemist with synthetic flavor profiles. (C) Trade Sinderion rare crimson Nirnroots from the depths of Blackreach: bypasses the wine request entirely through peerless botanical discovery.
Q_OBLIVION_ALTERATION_TRAINING: Tooth-in-the-Crow near Bravil tests your mastery of elemental breathing and buoyancy in deep water. (A) Dive into Niben Bay and remain submerged for an entire day and night without surfacing: proves complete command over Alteration respiration and earns master training. (B) Construct an enchanted diving apparatus using Welkynd glass: achieves the trial through engineering rather than pure spellcraft. (C) Defeat deep-water slaughterfish and dreugh while meditating on the seabed: combines martial survival with aquatic elemental focus.
Q_OBLIVION_ARMORER_TRAINING: Gin-Wulm in the Imperial City Market District requires you to present an authentic copy of the historical treatise 'The Armorer's Challenge'. (A) Track down the rare book from First Edition or provincial collectors and present it to Gin-Wulm: unlocks master armorer skills, allowing repair beyond 100% durability. (B) Transcribe a damaged copy yourself using historical metallurgical knowledge: earns the master's respect through scholarly craftsmanship. (C) Challenge Gin-Wulm to forge an Ebony breastplate from raw ore under time pressure: tests practical anvil mastery directly.
Q_OBLIVION_ATHLETICS_TRAINING: Roxaee at the Wawnet Inn tests your physical endurance and long-distance running capability across Cyrodiil. (A) Sprint from the shores of Lake Rumare across the Imperial Reserve without pausing to rest: proves superhuman stamina and earns master athletics. (B) Use speed-enhancing alchemical stimulants and wind enchantments: reaches the threshold through alchemical bio-engineering. (C) Run the gauntlet alongside wild mountain lions: turns endurance running into a lethal exercise in wilderness survival.
Q_OBLIVION_BLADE_TRAINING: Alix Lencolia at the Faregyl Inn requires a candidate with formidable martial renown and international sword pedigree. (A) Prove your fame and martial reputation by presenting trophies from the Imperial Arena and battlefields: earns Alix's master blade techniques and signature disarm maneuvers. (B) Duel Alix in an honorable non-lethal spar in the inn's courtyard: earns his respect through immediate blade-to-blade steel mastery. (C) Show him the ancient Akaviri sword arts learned from Cloud Ruler Temple: trades eastern fencing theory for master imperial footwork.
Q_OBLIVION_BLOCK_TRAINING: Andragil in Bravil tests your defense by having you withstand a relentless barrage of attacks without striking back. (A) Raise your shield and absorb every crushing blow from Andragil's warhammer without yielding an inch: earns master block, enabling knockback counter-attacks. (B) Use an enchanted reflection shield to deflect the kinetic force back onto Andragil: demonstrates defensive ingenuity at the cost of nearly toppling your mentor. (C) Parry her strikes using a lightweight buckler and tactical footwork: adapts the master block trial for an agile skirmisher.
Q_OBLIVION_BLUNT_TRAINING: Irene Metrick at Elven Gardens demands you slaughter 50 enemies with blunt weapons before she will teach you. (A) Prove your ruthless count of fallen foes with maces and warhammers in bandit lairs: satisfies Irene's bloodthirsty requirement and earns master blunt training. (B) Challenge Irene to a devastating heavy mace duel in the sewers: earns her respect directly without grinding random road bandits. (C) Refuse to engage in senseless slaughter, demonstrating that crushing weapons are meant for defending the weak: attempts to shift Irene's brutal philosophy.
Q_OBLIVION_CONJURATION_TRAINING: Olyn Seran at the Molag Bal shrine tests your ability to bind and summon a high-tier Faded Wraith. (A) Cast the summon spell and hold the terrifying Faded Wraith under complete mental command: proves supreme conjuration dominance and unlocks master training. (B) Bind two divergent extraplanar entities simultaneously: pushes the limits of mortal summoning, risking an extraplanar breach at the shrine. (C) Banish a wild summoned Daedra that attacks the shrine: earns Olyn's admiration by rectifying another summoner's catastrophic mistake.
Q_OBLIVION_DESTRUCTION_TRAINING: Bralsa Andaren, wandering the wilderness outside the Imperial City, demands 20 bear pelts to channel primal elemental rage. (A) Deliver the 20 fresh bear pelts to Bralsa: proves martial grit and earns master destruction, unlocking world-ending elemental devastation. (B) Demonstrate a custom-woven master flame and frost spell directly before her: earns her training through raw magical brilliance rather than tedious pelt collection. (C) Shield Bralsa from a pack of savage forest wolves: earns her respect by protecting a distracted, eccentric arch-mage.
Q_OBLIVION_HAND_TO_HAND_TRAINING: Helvius Cecia in Bruma insists that you beat him down in an unarmored fistfight until he yields. (A) Spar with Helvius using raw bare fists, dodging his jabs and pummeling him into submission: earns master hand-to-hand training and paralyzing unarmed strikes. (B) Use pressure-point grappling and submission holds: defeats Helvius with surgical discipline rather than bruising slugging. (C) Intentionally take his hardest hits to demonstrate pain tolerance: earns his respect through sheer, unbreakable Nord endurance.
Q_OBLIVION_HEAVY_ARMOR_TRAINING: Pranal at the Roxey Inn requires you to present a set of fine silver glasses and a pitcher as a gift for Malene. (A) Acquire the fine silver dining set from imperial nobility and present it to Malene on Pranal's behalf: softens the old warrior's heart and unlocks master heavy armor training. (B) Trade a set of pristine ancient Dwarven plate armor to Pranal instead: appeals to his warrior roots rather than his romantic aspirations. (C) Slay the bandit gang harassing Roxey Inn: provides the practical security Pranal wishes he could provide himself.
Q_OBLIVION_ILLUSION_TRAINING: Martina Floria at the Arcane University Chironasium requires 10 Welkynd Stones to fuel esoteric phantasmagoria. (A) Explore ancient Ayleid ruins to harvest 10 pristine Welkynd Stones for Martina: unlocks master illusion, allowing spells to command entire crowds of enemies. (B) Cast a grand mass-delusion spell across the University grounds: demonstrates illusion mastery directly, terrifying the apprentice mages. (C) Bribe an Ayleid antiquities dealer to purchase the stones: avoids hazardous ruins through mercantile wealth.
Q_OBLIVION_LIGHT_ARMOR_TRAINING: J'bari in Leyawiin demands you bring him an authentic set of Elven Cuirass armor to prove your aesthetic standards. (A) Hunt down rogue Thalmor scouts or high-level bandits to obtain the gleaming golden Elven Cuirass: earns master light armor training, granting full protection without encumbrance. (B) Forge the Elven Cuirass yourself using moonstone ore and quicksilver: earns J'bari's admiration for artisan metallurgy. (C) Steal the ceremonial Elven Cuirass from Castle Leyawiin's royal armory: demonstrates roguish audacity alongside armor appreciation.
Q_OBLIVION_MARKSMAN_TRAINING: Alawen at Troll Candle Camp requires an authentic Elven Bow before she will teach her lethal archery secrets. (A) Procure a pristine Elven Bow from an expert fletcher or elven ranger and present it to Alawen: unlocks master marksman, enabling paralyzing sniper headshots. (B) Win an archery trick-shot competition at 100 paces against Alawen: proves your supreme marksmanship without needing an expensive bow gift. (C) Enchant her personal bow with storm lightning: enriches her hunting gear in exchange for master woodland marksmanship.
Q_OBLIVION_MERCANTILE_TRAINING: Palonirya in the Imperial City Market District requires you to amass a personal liquid fortune of 10,000 gold. (A) Present your 10,000 gold bankroll to Palonirya: proves financial mastery and unlocks master mercantile, allowing investment in any merchant's shop. (B) Corner the market on Cyrodiilic wine or glass weapons: proves economic monopoly and commercial acumen directly to Palonirya. (C) Audit Palonirya's private trade ledgers: uncovers tax-evasion loopholes, using commercial leverage to secure master training.
Q_OBLIVION_MYSTICISM_TRAINING: Dagail in Leyawiin demands that you locate and visit at least 5 ancient Daedric or Ayleid standing stones. (A) Trek across Cyrodiil to commune with five ancient celestial standing stones: attunes your mind to the Aurbis and unlocks master mysticism. (B) Meditate atop the White-Gold Tower under a conjunction of the moons: achieves mystical enlightenment through cosmic alignment. (C) Absorb the residual metaphysical aura from an open Oblivion Gate: exposes your spirit to raw extraplanar flux to force mystical insight.
Q_OBLIVION_RESTORATION_TRAINING: Oleta at the Chapel of Akatosh in Kvatch requires you to heal the sick and wounded survivors of Kvatch's refugee camp. (A) Cast high-tier healing and cure disease spells on the injured refugees at Kvatch camp: restores hope to the desperate and unlocks master restoration. (B) Cleanse the blighted necrotic soil around Kvatch using consecration: heals the land itself to prevent lingering Daedric plague. (C) Synthesize rare restorative salves using mountain herbs: provides physical medicine alongside divine magic to ease refugee suffering.
Q_OBLIVION_SECURITY_TRAINING: J'baana in the Imperial City Prison requires you to retrieve a secret package from S'Krivva in Bravil. (A) Deliver S'Krivva's contraband lock-picking gear to J'baana inside the prison: unlocks master security, rendering lockpicks unbreakable. (B) Pick the master-level lock on the Imperial City treasury to prove your talent directly: proves unmatched lockpicking skill before J'baana's eyes. (C) Help J'baana escape from his prison cell: turns the security trial into a daring jailbreak, earning his eternal criminal brotherhood.
Q_OBLIVION_SNEAK_TRAINING: Marana Rian in the Imperial City Temple District tests your stealth by challenging you to pickpocket a special coin from her purse. (A) Slip behind Marana in broad daylight and lift the coin without alerting her keen senses: earns master sneak, allowing you to run silently in heavy shadows. (B) Use an invisibility spell to snatch the coin: passes the test through arcane stealth, though Marana critiques your reliance on magic. (C) Pickpocket the captain of the Imperial Watch while standing right next to Marana: proves supreme pickpocketing audacity in front of your trainer.
Q_OBLIVION_SPEECHCRAFT_TRAINING: Tandilwe at the Temple of the One requires you to speak with and gain the friendship of all 19 beggars across Cyrodiil. (A) Travel to every county, listen to each beggar's story, and give generous alms: earns master speechcraft and the enduring affection of Cyrodiil's underclass. (B) Organize a charitable soup kitchen network across the major cities: solves the structural poverty of Cyrodiil's beggars, astonishing Tandilwe with systemic compassion. (C) Use charm and hypnotic voice tricks to compel provincial counts to grant beggar pardons: leverages speechcraft for political reform.
Q_OBLIVION_A_BROTHERHOOD_BETRAYED: Raynil Dralas posed as a vampire hunter to murder Bradon Lirrian and steal the Mundane Amulet. (A) Hunt down Raynil at Boreal Stone Cave, execute him, and return the amulet to Erline: clears Bradon's name and uncovers the true magical Phylactery of Litheness.
