(B) Demand Raynil hand over his co-conspirators' plunder before slaying him: extracts hidden treasure caches in Bruma at the expense of delayed justice. (C) Keep the Mundane Amulet without revealing its secret enchantment to Erline: exploits a grieving widow to retain an enchanted ward.
Q_OBLIVION_A_BRUSH_WITH_DEATH: Painter Rythe Lythandas is trapped inside his magical Painted World by a rogue thief wielding painted trolls. (A) Enter the canvas, slay the painted trolls using turpentine, retrieve the magic brush, and paint an exit: saves Rythe and receives the enchanted Apron of Adroitness. (B) Study the metaphysical properties of the magic paintbrush: learns reality-altering illusion painting before returning Rythe to Cheydinhal. (C) Leave Rythe in the canvas temporarily to explore the painted realm: plunders the whimsical dreamscape, risking permanent entrapment.
Q_OBLIVION_A_RING_OF_KEYS: A complex subterranean network of locked gates beneath Chorrol holds forgotten heirloom caches. (A) Recover all ancient skeleton keys through meticulous lockpicking and crypt exploration: unlocks the city's hidden reserve vaults. (B) Use sonic blast spells to shatter the iron gates: breaches the vaults rapidly, alerting city guards to the underground detonation. (C) Sell the key ring to the Thieves Guild: trades historical access for underworld fence favor.
Q_OBLIVION_A_SHADOW_OVER_HACKDIRT: Dar-Ma has been kidnapped by the sinister, xenophobic subterranean cult of Hackdirt worshipping 'The Deep Ones'. (A) Infiltrate Hackdirt's chapel and cavern labyrinth, rescue Dar-Ma from the altar, and escort her to Chorrol: reunites mother and daughter, earning free merchant training. (B) Burn Hackdirt and purge its mutated 'Brethren' to the ground: destroys the Deep Ones cult permanently, avenging vanished travelers. (C) Commune with the subterranean Deep Ones beneath the altar: glimpses ancient eldritch entities at the cost of sanity.
Q_OBLIVION_A_VENERABLE_VINTAGE: Nerussa at the Wawnet Inn seeks six rare bottles of Shadowbanish Wine, brewed long ago for soldiers in the dark. (A) Scour ancient ruined imperial forts (Fort Grief, Fort Scinia, Fort Carmala) to retrieve the six glowing bottles: completes the collection and earns Nerussa's hefty bounty. (B) Drink the vintage yourself to gain permanent night-eye vision: sacrifices economic profit for supernatural subterranean sight. (C) Sell the rare bottles to Countess Alessia Caro: introduces ancient vintage to the high court for aristocratic favor.
Q_OBLIVION_A_WOUND_IN_TIME: An anomalous temporal tear near the Jerall Mountains threatens to loop historical conflicts endlessly. (A) Anchor the chronological rift with Welkynd focus crystals: stabilizes provincial timeline continuity and seals the temporal hazard. (B) Step through the rift to witness ancient First Era Alessian battles: acquires lost combat techniques directly from historical champions. (C) Collapse the rift with wild destructive pyromancy: closes the tear violently, scarring the surrounding mountainside.
Q_OBLIVION_AN_UNEXPECTED_VOYAGE: While sleeping at the Bloated Float inn on the Waterfront, the ship is hijacked and steered out to sea by the Blackwater Bandits. (A) Subdue or slay Lynch, Minx, Wrath, and Ormil's traitor Selene: retakes the vessel bloodlessly where possible and docks back in the Imperial City. (B) Join forces with the Blackwater Bandits: turns pirate, sailing the Bloated Float into Niben Bay as a floating smuggler fortress. (C) Parley with Ormil and trick the bandits into surrendering their swords: proves cunning diplomacy over swordsmanship.
Q_OBLIVION_ATTACK_ON_FORT_SUTCH: Imperial Legion forces and Daedric invaders clash in an open assault outside the ruins of Fort Sutch. (A) Rally the Imperial Legion vanguard, breach the Daedric perimeter, and sever the Sigil Stone: secures Fort Sutch for the Empire. (B) Allow the Daedric shock troops and legionnaires to slaughter each other before claiming the ruin: loots both sides' corpses with zero personal risk. (C) Deploy mass area elemental bombardment: wipes out the entire warzone, obliterating Daedra and Legion alike.
Q_OBLIVION_BATTLEHORN_CASTLE_QUEST: Battlehorn Castle is besieged by marauders; Lord Jaren needs an honorable champion to reclaim the fortress. (A) Break the siege, defeat the marauder chieftain, and restore Battlehorn Castle as your martial headquarters: establishes a grand player stronghold and garrison. (B) Discover the castle's secret subterranean grottos and dragon relics: unlocks ancient hidden vaults beneath the keep. (C) Levy exorbitant feudal taxes on surrounding farms to fund lavish castle renovations: enriches your personal treasury at the expense of peasant prosperity.
Q_OBLIVION_BEAR_SEASON: Thorley Aethelred's farm near Shardrock is under siege by aggressive West Weald brown bears. (A) Track down and eliminate the six rogue bears threatening the livestock: secures the farm and earns Thorley's gratitude and enchanted teeth. (B) Relocate the bear dens into the nearby bandit encampments: uses nature's apex predators to wipe out local highwaymen. (C) Demand half the farm's harvest as protection tribute: turns a neighborly defense into a mercenary extortion racket.
Q_OBLIVION_BITTNELD_AND_EMFRID: Bittneld, Chorrol's lonely captain of the guard, needs encouragement to notice Emfrid, the welcoming innkeeper of The Oak and Crosier. (A) Play matchmaker through heartfelt conversation, bringing Bittneld and Emfrid together: brings joy and warmth to Chorrol's tavern. (B) Advise Bittneld to focus solely on military discipline and guard patrols: sharpens town vigilance at the cost of domestic romance. (C) Spread malicious tavern gossip that Bittneld prefers tavern wenches in Skingrad: creates petty town drama for personal amusement.
Q_OBLIVION_BLACK_BOW_BANDITS: Count Marius Caro of Leyawiin pays a bounty for every Black Bow recovered from Mazoga's outlaw rivals. (A) Hunt down Black Bow bandits across Blackwood and turn in their bows to Count Caro: systematically cleanses the bandit plague and earns 100 gold per bow. (B) Sell the enchanted Black Bows on the underworld black market: yields higher profits while arming Waterfront cutpurses. (C) Uncover the Black Bows' secret supply line in Rockmilk Cave: strikes at the heart of their criminal leadership.
Q_OBLIVION_BURNING_TRAIL: A fiery scorch trail through the Great Forest signals an escaped flame atronach or reckless pyromancer. (A) Follow the charred path, defeat the rogue elemental, and quench the forest fire: saves the woodland from an ecological disaster. (B) Trap the rogue flame atronach in a soul vessel: harnesses prime fire energy for weapon enchanting. (C) Steer the blazing trail toward an encroaching goblin settlement: uses the natural firestorm to clear out a monster tribe.
Q_OBLIVION_BUY_A_HOUSE_IN_THE_IMPERIAL_C: Vinicia Melissaeia in the Office of Imperial Commerce offers a modest waterfront shack for 2,000 gold. (A) Purchase the shack and furnish it with basic home comforts: establishes a modest, humble safehouse in the capital. (B) Use the shack as a clandestine stash house for stolen guild artifacts: turns the humble dwelling into a thieves' sanctuary. (C) Bribe Vinicia to slash the property deed cost: secures the house below market value through bureaucratic manipulation.
Q_OBLIVION_BUYING_A_HOUSE_IN_BRAVIL: Count Regulus Terentius offers a weathered wooden home above the Bravil canals for 4,000 gold. (A) Purchase the home and renovate it with local tapestries: brings cozy pride to a decrepit city neighborhood. (B) Convert the canal home into a secret skooma den: profits off Bravil's narcotics trade, alienating the city guard. (C) Inspect the home's foundations to discover hidden canal smuggling pipes: links your basement directly to Niben Bay.
Q_OBLIVION_BUYING_A_HOUSE_IN_CHEYDINHAL: Count Andel Indarys offers a spacious timbered home in Cheydinhal for 15,000 gold. (A) Purchase and fully furnish the Cheydinhal estate: earns aristocratic standing among the local Dunmer and Imperial nobility. (B) House political dissidents and refugees within the estate: uses aristocratic property to protect fugitives from the Count's guard. (C) Resell the deed at double price to an Altmer merchant: executes high-yield real estate speculation in eastern Cyrodiil.
Q_OBLIVION_BUYING_A_HOUSE_IN_LEYAWIIN: Count Marius Caro offers a charming southern home in Leyawiin for 7,000 gold. (A) Purchase and furnish the Leyawiin residence: secures an anchor near the Elsweyr and Black Marsh border. (B) Host cross-border trade summits between Argonian and Khajiit traders in your parlor: fosters southern regional harmony. (C) Fortify the manor with hidden archer slits: prepares a defensive bastion against regional unrest.
Q_OBLIVION_BUYING_A_HOUSE_IN_SKINGRAD: Shum gro-Yarug offers Rosethorn Hall, the grandest manor in Skingrad, for 25,000 gold. (A) Purchase Rosethorn Hall and hire Eyja as your maid: claims the pinnacle of luxury, prestige, and privacy in Cyrodiil. (B) Uncover the hidden attic secret of the Rosethorn cache: solves the manor's architectural riddle to claim forgotten gems. (C) Host extravagant wine-tasting banquets for Count Hassildor: integrates into Skingrad's vampire aristocracy.
Q_OBLIVION_CANVAS_THE_CASTLE: Countess Valga of Castle Chorrol needs an investigator to discover who stole the portrait of her late husband. (A) Interrogate suspects, analyze the painting supplies in the West Tower, and accuse Chanel: uncovers a crime born of grief, returning the painting. (B) Lie to Countess Valga, concealing Chanel's guilt: spares an aging court mage from prison while Chanel rewards you with a portrait. (C) Accuse Orgnolf the steward for his gambling debts: ruins an innocent man's career to protect court secrets.
Q_OBLIVION_CAUGHT_IN_THE_HUNT: Orcus and Kurdan gro-Dragol trap you on Fort Grief island, forcing you into a deadly manhunt as human prey. (A) Hunt down Kurdan's hunters, turn the tables in the ruins, rescue Aleron Loche, and slay Kurdan: ends the sadistic bloodsport and frees the captive. (B) Loot the hunters' enchanted armor and weapons: outfits yourself with master gear while stalking through the foggy island. (C) Expose the Fort Grief bloodsport to the Bravil authorities: triggers an Imperial Legion amphibious raid on the island.
Q_OBLIVION_CORRUPTION_AND_CONSCIENCE: Captain Ulrich Leland is imposing exorbitant, ruinous fines on Cheydinhal citizens, driving Llevana Nedaren to vengeance. (A) Gather evidence with Garrus Darelliun to expose Ulrich legally, putting him in prison: preserves justice without bloodshed and promotes Garrus. (B) Allow Llevana Nedaren to lure Ulrich to her home and feed him to her pet rats: delivers visceral poetic vengeance at the cost of Llevana's soul. (C) Blackmail Ulrich for a portion of the extortion money: profits off the suffering of Cheydinhal's citizens.
Q_OBLIVION_DAEDRIC_QUESTS: Ancient shrines to the sixteen Daedric Lords are scattered across Cyrodiil, each demanding tribute. (A) Undertake the trials of all Daedric Princes, mastering their lessons while retaining your mortal moral compass: earns Tamriel's legendary relics. (B) Purge the violent cult shrines with paladin fury: cleanses Cyrodiil of extraplanar heresy. (C) Broker an alliance between competing Daedric cultists: incites turf wars between worshippers of Molag Bal and Meridia.
Q_OBLIVION_DEEPSCORN_HOLLOW_QUEST: Deepscorn Hollow provides an underground sanctuary for assassins and vampires, featuring the Shrine of Sithis and the Purge Fountain. (A) Restore the lair with dark thralls, venom gardens, and the Font of Renewal: creates the ultimate nocturnal retreat. (B) Consecrate the subterranean cavern to Arkay: seals the vampire nest forever, destroying its unholy waters. (C) Breed mutated slaughterfish in the subterranean pool: turns the grotto into a lethal aquatic trap.
Q_OBLIVION_DUNBARROW_COVE_QUEST: The subterranean smugglers' haven of Dunbarrow Cove lies beneath Castle Anvil, haunted by skeleton pirate ghosts. (A) Cleanse the undead pirates and recruit smuggler merchants, fences, and trainers: establishes the Red Sabre pirate guild under your command. (B) Send your pirate crew on high-seas raiding voyages: generates passive weekly plunder from naval piracy. (C) Reveal the smugglers' entrance to the Anvil town guard: collects an Imperial bounty, sacrificing your private outlaw harbor.
Q_OBLIVION_E3_DEMO_QUEST: Explore the historic dungeon showcase featuring dynamic physics, radiant AI, and ragdoll combat. (A) Navigate the historic dungeon, triggering the rolling boulder traps and physics demonstrations: honors the classic origins of the Cyrodiil adventure. (B) Exploit the physics engine to launch enemies across the cavern: tests the limits of the mechanical sandbox for combat efficiency. (C) Map the architectural geometry for custom dungeon construction: preserves legacy design blueprints.
Q_OBLIVION_FROSTCRAG_SPIRE_QUEST: The wizard tower of Frostcrag Spire stands atop the snowy peaks of the Jerall Mountains, awaiting an arcane heir. (A) Restore the spire's enchanting altars, spellmaking stations, and alchemy garden: creates the premier private magical observatory in Tamriel. (B) Summon the elemental atronach familiars to patrol the mountain pass: secures the northern border with arcane sentries. (C) Conduct high-altitude astronomical research into the moons: decodes cosmic planar alignments from the celestial tower.
Q_OBLIVION_GO_FISH: Aelwin Merowald in Weye needs 12 Rumare Slaughterfish scales to fund his retirement, but his leg is crippled. (A) Dive into Lake Rumare, hunt the ferocious slaughterfish, and present the scales to Aelwin: earns the Jewel of the Rumare, granting water breathing. (B) Steal Aelwin's retirement savings from his house chest: betrays a helpless old fisherman for easy early coin. (C) Cast mass frenzy on the slaughterfish school: turns the lake into a swirling aquatic feeding frenzy, harvesting scales effortlessly.
Q_OBLIVION_GOBLIN_TROUBLE: Barthel Gernand and his settlers at Crestbridge Camp are caught between the warring Rock Biter and Bloody Hand goblin tribes. (A) Steal the sacred Goblin Totem Staff from Timberscar Cave and return it to its rightful altar: ends the goblin tribal war peacefully and saves Crestbridge. (B) Slay both goblin shamans and their warbands in open combat: wipes out both tribes with steel, eliminating the threat through extermination. (C) Plant the Totem Staff inside the Crestbridge settlers' tents: provokes a goblin horde to overrun the settlement.
Q_OBLIVION_HELPING_HANDS: Eyja, an out-of-work Nord woman in Skingrad, seeks employment as a housekeeper for Rosethorn Hall. (A) Hire Eyja at generous wages, providing her with food, lodging, and dignified work: establishes a warm, welcoming atmosphere in your estate. (B) Task Eyja with brewing Rosethorn's rare vintages: turns your manor into an artisanal private winery. (C) Overwork Eyja with grueling manor maintenance for minimal pay: maximizes personal savings through aristocratic exploitation.
Q_OBLIVION_HORSE_ARMOR_QUEST: Snak gra-Bura at the Chestnut Handy Stables offers protective steel or elven armor for your mount. (A) Outfit your loyal steed with gleaming steel barding: doubles your mount's health and survivability against wilderness predators. (B) Commission lightweight golden elven barding: maximizes speed and agility for cross-country scouting. (C) Test the horse armor's durability against mountain bandit arrows: confirms metallurgical resilience on the road.
Q_OBLIVION_ILLEGAL_CARGO: Smugglers are trafficking forbidden Akaviri contraband and exotic beasts through the Niben River. (A) Intercept the smuggler barges, seize the contraband, and arrest the ringleader: upholds imperial maritime law and customs. (B) Confiscate the exotic beasts and train them as personal guard companions: turns contraband into loyal war beasts. (C) Accept a bribe to grant the smugglers safe passage through Leyawiin: opens an ongoing illicit revenue stream.
Q_OBLIVION_IMPERIAL_CORRUPTION: Captain Audens Avidius is extorting merchants in the Imperial City, and Jensine seeks a brave soul to report him. (A) Convince two shopkeepers to testify and report Avidius to Captain Servatius Quintilius or Garrus Darelliun: sees Avidius stripped of his rank and jailed. (B) Slay Avidius in a dark alley: removes the corrupt watch captain immediately, bypassing the sluggish legal bureaucracy. (C) Warn Avidius of the merchants' complaint: earns the corrupt captain's protection in the market district.
Q_OBLIVION_KNIGHTS_OF_THE_NINE_QUESTS: The ancient sorcerer-king Umaril the Unfeathered has returned, desecrating chapels; the Crusader's Relics must be found. (A) Walk the Pilgrimage of the Nine, assemble the holy relics, and resurrect the Knights of the Nine: defeats Umaril in mortal and spiritual planes. (B) Refuse to yield mortal will to the Divines, seeking a purely martial way to challenge Umaril: tests mortal steel against an Ayleid demigod. (C) Seal the Chapel of Anvil and evacuate Cyrodiil's priests: mitigates civilian casualties while Umaril consolidates power.
Q_OBLIVION_KNIGHTS_OF_THE_WHITE_STALLION: Count Marius Caro enlists you and Mazoga the Orc to clear the bandit lair of Telepe and become Knights-Errant. (A) Storm Telepe with Mazoga, slay Black Brugo and his gang, and receive the White Stallion Knight insignia: earns the White Stallion Lodge as a base. (B) Let Mazoga take all the glory and the official knighthood: honors your Orc comrade's dream of redemptive honor. (C) Ambush Black Brugo outside Telepe during his midnight gold drop: eliminates the bandit leader before he can enter his fortified redoubt.
Q_OBLIVION_LEGACY_LOST: Guilbert and Reynald Jemane have learned their ancestral home of Weatherleah is infested by ferocious red ogres. (A) Clear the ogres from Weatherleah and escort the Jemane brothers back to their restored family estate: brings closure to the reunited twins. (B) Fortify Weatherleah with wooden palisades: turns the recovered farm into an armed outpost against mountain monsters. (C) Demand half of Weatherleah's land in exchange for reclaiming it: extracts property from the grateful brothers.
Q_OBLIVION_LEVELED_ITEM_QUESTS: Artifacts and enchanted gear throughout Cyrodiil scale in power with your heroic renown and experience. (A) Delay claiming signature relics until reaching master renown: maximizes the enchantment magnitude of quest rewards across the province. (B) Claim relics immediately to overcome early crises: uses practical advantages when survival is most precarious. (C) Re-enchant signature quest relics at the Arcane University: overrides ancient enchantments with custom spell combinations.
Q_OBLIVION_LICH_OF_LOST_BOY_CAVERN: The tragic journals of Erandur-Vangaril in Lost Boy Cavern tell of a mage who sacrificed his sanity to bind his lich friend. (A) Slay the tragic lich Erandur-Vangaril, freeing both entwined souls from eternal necrotic torment: cleanses the haunted cavern. (B) Study Erandur's journals on soul-transference: gains deep theoretical insights into necromantic soul binding. (C) Seal the entrance of Lost Boy Cavern with stone wards: leaves the tragic entity undisturbed in eternal subterranean isolation.
Q_OBLIVION_LIFTING_THE_VALE: Countess Narina Carvain of Bruma seeks the ancient Akaviri heirloom, the Madstone of Springhill, lost in Pale Pass. (A) Trek through Pale Pass, survive the frozen ogres and Akaviri undead in Sancre Tor, and return the Madstone: earns the Ring of the Vipereye. (B) Keep the Madstone of Springhill for its constant-effect magical protections: forfeits the Countess's reward for an ancient Akaviri talisman. (C) Deliver the Madstone to the Blades at Cloud Ruler Temple: places the Akaviri relic among historians rather than a noble's jewelry box.
Q_OBLIVION_MAIN_QUEST: The cosmic crisis of the Oblivion invasion demands coordination between the Blades, the Emperor, and provincial garrisons. (A) Focus strictly on the primary crisis to seal the Dragonfires before Cyrodiil collapses: ensures existential preservation of the mortal realm. (B) Divert resources to fortify vulnerable rural settlements and county seats: prevents horrific civilian slaughter at the cost of slower grand strategy. (C) Study the mechanics of the Daedric gates to develop magical counter-portals: seeks proactive offensive magic against Mehrunes Dagon.
Q_OBLIVION_MAZOGA_THE_ORC_QUEST: Mazoga, a gruff Orc residing in Castle Leyawiin, claims to be a knight and demands to speak with Count Marius Caro. (A) Help Mazoga track down the bandit Weebam-Na and avenge her fallen friend Ra'vindra: earns Mazoga's fierce, unwavering friendship. (B) Expose Mazoga's criminal past to Count Caro's guards: has the errant Orc arrested, ending her quest for vengeance. (C) Duel Mazoga in the castle courtyard to test her claims of knighthood: earns her respect through honorable martial combat.
Q_OBLIVION_NO_STONE_UNTURNED: Lithnilian lost his research notes on Welkynd stone formation inside Bramblepoint Cave. (A) Clear the cavern beasts, recover Lithnilian's research notes, and return them: advances scholarly understanding of Ayleid geology. (B) Study the research notes yourself to identify pristine Welkynd veins: locates untouched crystal nodes across Cyrodiil. (C) Sell the academic papers to the Arcane University Chironasium: monetizes the field researcher's discoveries.
Q_OBLIVION_NOTHING_YOU_CAN_POSSESS: Umbacano hires you to retrieve a carving from the Ayleid ruin of Malada, competing against rival treasure hunter Claude Maric. (A) Navigate Malada, recover the carving, and defeat Claude Maric's ambush outside: secures the relic and establishes dominance over rival collectors. (B) Negotiate a peaceful split with Claude Maric at the ruin entrance: avoids bloodshed between Cyrodiil's top antiquarians. (C) Keep the Malada carving for your own private collection: defies Umbacano's patron contract to preserve the artifact.
Q_OBLIVION_ORDER_OF_THE_VIRTUOUS_BLOOD_Q: Gwendolyn and Seridur invite you to join the Order of the Virtuous Blood, accusing Roland Jenseric of being a vampire. (A) Investigate Roland's cabin, discover that Seridur is the true vampire, and slay Seridur in Memorial Cave: cleanses the Order and establishes Roland as its true leader. (B) Slay Roland Jenseric on Seridur's word: executes an innocent man, allowing a vampire lord to manipulate Imperial City high society. (C) Blackmail Seridur regarding his vampirism: extorts massive hush money from the undead aristocrat.
Q_OBLIVION_ORIGIN_OF_THE_GRAY_PRINCE: Agronak gro-Malog, Grand Champion of the Imperial Arena, begs you to find proof of his noble blood in Crowhaven. (A) Journey to Crowhaven, discover Lord Lovidicus's journal proving Agronak is half-vampire, and show him: shatters his pride, causing him to refuse to fight you in the Arena. (B) Conceal the journal and tell Agronak he is descended from an honorable Imperial knight: preserves his dignity and warrior spirit for a glorious final duel. (C) Threaten to publish the journal to the Arena spectators: extorts the Grand Champion for gold before the championship bout.
Q_OBLIVION_PARANOIA: Glarthir in Skingrad believes three townspeople are plotting his death and pays you to spy on them. (A) Investigate Bernadette, Toutius, and Davide, proving to Glarthir that they are innocent: triggers his violent madness, forcing you to put him down in self-defense. (B) Confirm Glarthir's paranoid delusions, collecting his gold bounties for each accused: allows an unhinged madman to eliminate peaceful citizens. (C) Report Glarthir's erratic behavior immediately to Captain Dion: puts Glarthir in the guard's protective custody, preventing bloodshed.
Q_OBLIVION_RAID_ON_GREYLAND: Lathon seeks help to avenge his fallen friend and eradicate the skooma dealers holed up in Greyland farmhouse. (A) Storm Greyland, eliminate Kylius Lonavo and his Marauder henchmen, and recover the skooma: cleanses Leyawiin's border and avenges Lathon. (B) Seize the refined skooma stash for sale in Bravil: enriches your personal coffers through southern contraband. (C) Allow Kylius to bribe you to frame Lathon: flips the bounty for a larger payout, corrupting southern justice.
Q_OBLIVION_REMASTERED_QUESTS: A comprehensive suite of remastered visual and systemic enhancements modernizes Cyrodiil's adventures. (A) Integrate dynamic environmental lighting and high-fidelity physics across all county operations: maximizes immersion and world reactivity. (B) Focus enhancements purely on combat responsiveness and spell-chaining: sharpens martial encounters across all dungeons. (C) Preserve classic legacy parameters with minimal visual polish: maintains pristine 2006 mechanical nostalgia.
Q_OBLIVION_REPAIRING_THE_ORRERY: Bothiel needs dwarven cogs, gears, and cylinders from bandit camps to restore the Arcane University Orrery. (A) Scour bandit camps across Cyrodiil, recover the dwarven machinery, and repair the Orrery: unlocks celestial blessings based on the phases of the moons. (B) Reverse-engineer the dwarven gears: adapts ancient automaton engineering for custom gear and traps. (C) Sell the dwarven mechanisms to an independent collector in Morrowind: profits off rare First Era brass artifacts.
Q_OBLIVION_REVENGE_SERVED_COLD: Corrick Northwode in Harm's Folly wants revenge on the goblins of Exhausted Mine who murdered his wife Kayleen. (A) Enter Exhausted Mine, slaughter the goblin tribe, and recover Kayleen's jade amulet for Corrick: brings peace to a grieving husband and earns an enchanted amulet. (B) Purge the entire mountain region of goblin warbands: prevents any further raids on Harm's Folly. (C) Keep Kayleen's jade amulet for its frost resistance: denies Corrick closure in exchange for personal gear.
Q_OBLIVION_SAVING_TIME_ITSELF: A metaphysical chronomantic disruption threatens the integrity of Cyrodiil's historical narrative. (A) Recalibrate the Elder Scroll temporal anchor: seals the disruption and preserves the linear history of the Septim dynasty. (B) Glimpse alternative timelines where Kvatch never fell: extracts parallel tactical strategies from divergent realities. (C) Allow minor temporal echoes to bleed into Cyrodiil: creates strange historical phenomena for arcane study.
Q_OBLIVION_SECRETS_OF_THE_AYLEIDS: Umbacano wants you to find the ancient Crown of Nenalata or the Crown of Lindai to claim the Ayleid throne. (A) Give Umbacano the cursed Crown of Lindai, causing the ancient throne at Nenalata to incinerate him: frees Cyrodiil from a reincarnated Ayleid tyrant. (B) Give Umbacano the authentic Crown of Nenalata: watches him transform into an ancient Ayleid sorcerer-king, forcing an epic boss duel. (C) Keep both Ayleid crowns for yourself: crowns yourself heir to the ancient Wild Elves, donning master-tier elven regalia.
Q_OBLIVION_SEEKING_YOUR_ROOTS: Sinderion in Skingrad needs batches of rare, glowing Nirnroot plants to brew the Elixir of Exploration. (A) Forage 100 Nirnroots along the rivers, lakes, and coasts of Cyrodiil: earns all four tiers of the Elixir of Exploration, granting permanent stat buffs. (B) Cultivate Nirnroot domestic seedlings in your private manor gardens: attempts the first successful artificial cultivation of the elusive plant. (C) Sell the Nirnroot samples to underground poisoners: brews lethal silent toxins from the plant's vibrational sap.
Q_OBLIVION_SEPARATED_AT_BIRTH: Reynald Jemane in Chorrol is baffled by rumors of his drunken debauchery in Cheydinhal, unaware of his twin brother Guilbert. (A) Travel to Cheydinhal, locate Guilbert Jemane, and reunite the long-separated twins in Chorrol: brings joy and tears of reunion to a fractured family. (B) Convince Guilbert that Reynald is a dangerous outlaw: drives the brothers further apart, claiming both of their finder's fees. (C) Impersonate the third brother: tricks the Jemane family into sharing their ancestral inheritance.
Q_OBLIVION_SIDE_QUESTS: Countless provincial mysteries, local rumors, and citizen grievances echo across the nine counties. (A) Diligently answer every citizen's plea across towns and hamlets: builds an enduring legacy as Cyrodiil's benevolent protector. (B) Prioritize contracts based purely on high-tier gold and artifact payouts: establishes a pragmatic, self-interested mercenary operation. (C) Use civic disputes to manipulate local county politics: elevates favored counts and mayors through selective intervention.
Q_OBLIVION_SINS_OF_THE_FATHER: Fathis Ules and Jemane brothers seek the Honorblade of Chorrol, stolen long ago by their father Albert Jemane. (A) Recover the Honorblade from Valley View Camp and return it to Castle Chorrol: restores the ancestral relic to the city and earns the Escutcheon of Chorrol. (B) Give the Honorblade to Fathis Ules for a huge gold payout: enriches yourself and a Thieves Guild fence, breaking Chorrol's faith. (C) Keep the Honorblade of Chorrol: equips a weightless, high-damage ebony longsword for personal battle.
Q_OBLIVION_TEARS_OF_THE_SAVIOR: S'drassa in the Leyawiin Mages Guild needs Garridan's Tears, frozen in frostfire atop Frostfire Glade. (A) Survive the freezing frostfire and the Frostfire Atronach, retrieving all five tears with heat protection: earns S'drassa's massive alchemical bounty. (B) Consume the Tears of the Savior yourself: gains permanent frost resistance at the expense of completing the guild collection. (C) Study the frostfire phenomenon to develop a new cryomantic spell: uncovers cold-fire destruction magic.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_COLLECTOR: Umbacano hires you to explore ancient Ayleid ruins across Cyrodiil and retrieve ten carved Ayleid Statues. (A) Delve into all ten Ayleid ruins, recovering every carved statue for Umbacano's private museum: earns over 10,000 gold and deep Ayleid lore. (B) Study the architectural glyphs in each ruin: decodes the religious schisms between ancient Ayleid city-states. (C) Melt down the statues to extract their raw Welkynd glass: forfeits historical preservation for raw enchanting conduits.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_CRIMSON_CAVE: Bandits have converted an ancient red-veined cavern into a heavily fortified smuggling redoubt. (A) Infiltrate Crimson Cave, eliminate the outlaw garrison, and recover stolen trade goods: clears a major chokepoint along the trade route. (B) Negotiate a toll-sharing treaty with the bandit captain: collects passive highway revenue at the cost of merchant grumbling. (C) Flood the cavern using nearby river sluices: washes the bandits away without entering combat.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_FORLORN_WATCHMAN_QUEST: The ghostly Forlorn Watchman appears every night at Bawnwatch Camp, gazing out over Niben Bay in sorrow. (A) Follow the ghost, discover the shipwreck of the Emma May, and defeat Gable the Traitor to free Captain Valentin: brings eternal peace to the drowned sailors. (B) Plunder the Emma May's sunken cargo hold for sea-dampened treasure: claims historical naval plunder. (C) Bind Captain Valentin's ghost to your command: gains a spectral nautical guardian for Niben Bay.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_GHOST_SHIP_OF_ANVIL: The crew of the Serpent's Wake was slaughtered by phantom spirits, and Varulae needs her crystal ball retrieved. (A) Board the ghost ship, fight through the spectral crew, and return the crystal ball to Varulae: earns the enchanted cutlass Redwave. (B) Keep the crystal ball for its divinatory clairvoyance: discovers Varulae's secret smuggling connections. (C) Cleanse the ship with holy water: frees the Serpent's Wake to sail again as an Anvil trading vessel.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_GRAVEFINDERS_REPOSE: Malene at the Roxey Inn wants the necromancer Raelys murdered in Moss Rock Cavern to protect travelers. (A) Clear Moss Rock Cavern, eliminate Raelys, and destroy his skeletal minions: protects the Red Ring Road and earns Malene's bounty. (B) Interrogate Raelys to learn why he fled the Arcane University: uncovers more fallout from Traven's ban on necromancy. (C) Help Raelys disguise his laboratory: keeps the necromancer safe in exchange for dark spell instruction.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_HORROR_OF_DIVE_ROCK: The journals of Agnar and Svenja atop Dive Rock tell of the legendary monstrous Uderfrykte Matron. (A) Track down the Uderfrykte Matron in the freezing blizzard, avenge the fallen lovers, and slay the beast: earns the Frostwyrm Bow. (B) Tame the mountain predator using beast mastery: turns Cyrodiil's most terrifying myth into a mountain guardian. (C) Recover Agnar's journal and return it to his kin in Skyrim: brings honorable Nord closure to a tragic saga.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_KILLING_FIELD: Valus Odiil needs help protecting his two sons, Rallus and Antus, from a goblin invasion at Odiil Farm. (A) Defend the Odiil farm, keeping both sons alive against waves of goblins: brings joyous victory to Valus and earns the Chillrend enchanted sword. (B) Allow the sons to fall in combat, clearing the goblins yourself: claims the sword while Valus weeps for his bloodline. (C) Construct defensive perimeter spike traps around the crops: defeats the goblins without risking the boys in melee combat.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_POTATO_SNATCHER: S'Jirra at the Faregyl Inn has had her famous jumbo potatoes stolen by a rogue ogre and cannot bake her bread. (A) Track the ogre to its forest camp, defeat it, and return the jumbo potatoes to S'Jirra: earns her famous potato bread, which provides immense health recovery. (B) Befriend the ogre by sharing the potatoes: discovers the creature was merely starving, teaching it basic foraging. (C) Eat the jumbo potatoes yourself: enjoys a hearty woodland meal while leaving Faregyl Inn without bread.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_ROSETHORN_CACHE: A hidden riddle inside Rosethorn Hall in Skingrad leads to a forgotten cache of gemstones in the attic. (A) Solve the riddle of the hourglass, climb the attic rafters, and recover the Long-Lost Ring and flawless gems: uncovers ancient family wealth. (B) Donate the gems to the Skingrad chapel of Julianos: earns divine favor through selfless philanthropy. (C) Use the gems to commission custom enchanted jewelry from the Arcane University: transforms the hoard into powerful battle rings.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_SIRENS_DECEPTION: An all-female gang of seductresses in Anvil is luring married men into their farmhouse and robbing them blind. (A) Agree to meet the sirens at the farmhouse, resist their charms, and bring the gang to justice with the Anvil guard: earns the gratitude of the wives. (B) Join the siren syndicate: helps them target the wealthiest merchants in Anvil for a share of the plunder. (C) Expose the unfaithful husbands publicly in the Anvil market: causes civic uproar, holding the straying men accountable.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_SUNKEN_ONE_QUEST: Slythe Seringi in Kvatch is obsessed with sacrificing offerings to 'The Sunken One' in Sandstone Cavern. (A) Enter Sandstone Cavern, discover that the Sunken One is a ferocious storm atronach, and destroy it: saves Slythe from his suicidal delusion. (B) Study Slythe's mad astrological journals: learns how Daedric energy warped local cavern flora. (C) Lead Slythe into the cavern to witness the monster: forces him to face the reality of his mad devotion.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_UNBEATEN_PATH: Explore uncharted paths and ancient wilderness ruins winding through the Colovian Highlands. (A) Map the ancient trails, clear wild monster nests, and establish marked waypoints: makes the Colovian frontier safe for pilgrims. (B) Ambush merchant caravans along the secluded trails: exploits the lack of guard patrols for highway plunder. (C) Establish a hidden hunter's redoubt in the highlands: creates an off-grid mountain refuge.
Q_OBLIVION_THE_WAYWARD_KNIGHT: Farwil Indarys, arrogant son of the Count of Cheydinhal, has charged into the Cheydinhal Oblivion Gate with his Knights of the Thorn. (A) Fight through the gate, protect Farwil from his own foolish recklessness, and collapse the gate: saves the Count's heir and earns induction into the Knights of the Thorn. (B) Let Farwil die in the lava, taking his signet ring back to the Count: claims the tragedy reward while ridding Cheydinhal of an obnoxious prince. (C) Carry Farwil's fallen knight Bremman safely out as well: ensures every knight survives, teaching Farwil true humility.
Q_OBLIVION_THROUGH_A_NIGHTMARE_DARKLY: Henantier is trapped inside his own surreal Dreamworld by an experimental amulet, and Kud-Ei begs for your help. (A) Don the Dreamworld Amulet, enter his subconscious, and conquer the trials of Perception, Resolve, Courage, and Patience: restores Henantier's sanity. (B) Exploit the Dreamworld's infinite reality: studies subconscious magical conjuration within Henantier's lucid dream. (C) Wake Henantier abruptly: damages his mental faculties permanently, ending the nightmare through blunt trauma.
Q_OBLIVION_TWO_SIDES_OF_THE_COIN: Jorundr in Bruma prison claims Arnora stole his gold and framed him; Arnora claims Jorundr buried it. (A) Get jailed to speak with Jorundr, uncover Tyrike's treachery, and recover the buried gold chest: delivers poetic justice and claims the treasure. (B) Slay Arnora, take her amulet, and lie to Jorundr: executes cold deception for personal gain. (C) Split the gold evenly between Jorundr and the Bruma town relief fund: uses the stolen hoard to repair city defenses.
Q_OBLIVION_UNEARTHING_MEHRUNES_RAZOR: Frathen Drothan has unearthed the ancient Ayleid ruin of Varsa Baalim to reclaim the dreaded Mehrunes' Razor. (A) Infiltrate Varsa Baalim, defeat Drothan's mercenaries and vampire minions, and claim Mehrunes' Razor: secures the legendary Daedric dagger of instant death. (B) Destroy the ancient Nefarivigum altar: seals the dark relic away forever to prevent future tyrants from wielding it. (C) Harness Drothan's research to enhance the Razor's soul-banishing enchantments: creates an even deadlier variant.
Q_OBLIVION_UNFINISHED_QUESTS: Unresolved rumors and half-completed investigations linger across Cyrodiil's tavern notice boards. (A) Methodically complete all lingering leads and contracts: leaves no stone unturned in your heroic saga. (B) Consolidate the rumors into a comprehensive intelligence dossier: sells provincial secrets to High Chancellor Ocato. (C) Ignore the petty rumors to focus purely on world-shattering crises: acts with grand strategic focus.
Q_OBLIVION_UNFRIENDLY_COMPETITION: Thoronir is underselling other Imperial City merchants; Jensine suspects he is obtaining goods through foul means. (A) Trail Thoronir, discover his grave-robbing supplier Agarmir, and slay Agarmir in the crypt: reforms Thoronir and restores honest commerce to the Market District. (B) Blackmail Thoronir into giving you wholesale discounts on grave-robbed goods: profits from desecration while keeping the supply open. (C) Turn both Thoronir and Agarmir over to the Imperial Watch: shuts down the store, eliminating an affordable vendor.
Q_OBLIVION_UNWANTED_TENANTS: A pack of unruly squatters and drunken ruffians has occupied an abandoned imperial estate. (A) Persuade or intimidate the squatters to vacate peacefully: avoids bloodshed and restores the property to lawful registry. (B) Slay the squatters in an armed raid: clears the estate ruthlessly, establishing your reputation as an uncompromising enforcer. (C) Help the squatters establish a communal farm: defends the impoverished settlers against aristocratic evictions.
Q_OBLIVION_VAMPIRE_CURE: Afflicted with vampirism, you seek Melisande of Drakelowe to brew the cure, which Count Hassildor also desperately needs for his wife. (A) Gather the five Grand Soul Gems, blood of an Argonian, nightshade, and garlic, brew the potion, and save yourself and Countess Hassildor: cures your curse and earns Hassildor's eternal gratitude. (B) Keep the single dose of cure for yourself: cures your own vampirism, leaving Countess Rona Hassildor to suffer in eternal agony. (C) Refuse the cure and master your vampiric powers: chooses the eternal night, becoming Cyrodiil's ultimate apex predator.
Q_OBLIVION_WHEN_THE_VOW_BREAKS: Rockmilk Cave bandits stole the ceremonial family mace of Kalthar from Mahei's home while he was away. (A) Infiltrate Rockmilk Cave, retrieve the mace from the marauders, and return it to Mahei: preserves his ancestral honor and marriage. (B) Slay the marauder warlords and claim the cavern as your private mercenary hideout: cleanses a major bandit hub. (C) Keep the enchanted mace for personal combat: wields an ancient family weapon in your own battles.
Q_OBLIVION_WHERE_SPIRITS_HAVE_LEASE: You purchase Benirus Manor in Anvil for an astonishingly low 2,500 gold, only to discover it is infested by vengeful ghosts. (A) Uncover the secret altar, locate Velwyn Benirus, and defeat the ancient lich Lorgren Benirus: breaks the curse, restoring Benirus Manor as a pristine luxury mansion. (B) Embrace Lorgren Benirus's necromantic legacy: turns the manor into a personal subterranean laboratory for dark magic. (C) Sell the haunted manor to an unsuspecting merchant: offloads the cursed property for a quick profit.
Q_OBLIVION_WHOM_GODS_ANNOY: Rosentia Gallenus in Leyawiin bought a cursed Daedric staff that causes four annoying Scamps to follow her everywhere. (A) Take the Staff of the Everscamp and deposit it in Darkfathom Cave to Sheogorath's shrine: frees Rosentia from the nuisance and earns the Ring of Sunfire. (B) Keep the Staff of the Everscamp in your inventory: uses the four immortal scamps as infinite targets for combat skill training. (C) Lead the four scamps into Castle Leyawiin's royal banquet: creates absurd chaotic disruption in the Count's court.
Q_OBLIVION_ZERO_VISIBILITY: The entire village of Aleswell has been turned permanently invisible by the reckless wizard Ancotar in Fort Caractacus. (A) Find Ancotar, obtain his reversal scroll and ring, and restore visibility to Aleswell: saves the villagers from madness and earns free lodging at the inn forever. (B) Cast the reversal scroll without wearing the ring of protection: restores the town at the cost of permanently damaging your own magical attributes. (C) Slay Ancotar and take his spellbook: uncovers permanent mass-invisibility formulas, leaving Aleswell invisible forever.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_A_BETTER_MOUSETRAP: Activate the ancient resonant resonator in Xedilian to restore the dungeon's psychological and lethal trials. (A) Recover the Crystal of Focal Justice, align the resonance nodes, and reactivate Xedilian: secures the realm's southern border and pleases Sheogorath. (B) Study the ancient architect's journals on psychological trauma: unlocks madness-inducing illusion mechanics before activating the machine. (C) Sabotage the resonator to disable the lethal spikes permanently: ensures Xedilian only drives adventurers mad rather than killing them.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_A_DOOR_IN_NIBEN_BAY: A bizarre stone doorway composed of faces and skulls has emerged in the waters of Niben Bay outside Bravil. (A) Guard Gaius Prentus from the raving madman emerging from the portal and step through into the Fringe: crosses the dimensional threshold into the Shivering Isles. (B) Seal the portal temporarily with Imperial battlemage wards: delays the encroaching madness to protect Nibenay civilians from psychic contagion. (C) Interrogate the gibbering madman regarding the Madgod's court: extracts chilling prophecies about the Greymarch before crossing over.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_A_LIQUID_SOLUTION: Sickly Bernice in Split desires the holy restorative brew of the Chalice of Reversal from Dunroot Burrow. (A) Consume Felldew, battle through the Elytra-infested tunnels, and bring the Chalice to Bernice: cures her psychosomatic affliction and earns her strange potion rewards. (B) Overcome Felldew withdrawal through sheer mental discipline without consuming extra sap: proves mortal fortitude over Daedric addiction. (C) Keep the Chalice of Reversal for its supernatural disease and poison purging properties: leaves Bernice ailing while claiming a potent healing relic.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_ADDICTION: Thadon, Duke of Mania, cannot create or govern without the euphoric, lethal green nectar known as Felldew. (A) Infiltrate Dunroot Burrow, suffer through Felldew addiction, and retrieve the Chalice of Reversal for Thadon: earns the Duke's manic favor and the Golden Saint escort. (B) Present Thadon with an alchemical substitute that cleanses his system: attempts to break the Duke's chemical enslavement, risking a manic rage. (C) Poison the Chalice with nightshade: accelerates the downfall of the Court of Mania in preparation for the Greymarch.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_BAITING_THE_TRAP: Oversee the torment of three Cyrodiil adventurers navigating the reactivated chambers of Xedilian alongside Kiliban Nyrandil. (A) Subject the adventurers to psychological horrors (illusions, mad swarms, ghost giants) rather than physical death: drives them into glorious Mania/Dementia, satisfying Sheogorath's sadistic artistry. (B) Trigger the lethal crushing traps to execute them swiftly: spares them the agony of lingering madness at the cost of bloodier butcher's work. (C) Free the adventurers from the dungeon via an emergency escape latch: defies the Madgod's protocol, allowing three traumatized mortals to flee to Cyrodiil.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_BRITHAUR_QUEST: Earil in Crucible wants you to deal with Brithaur, an eccentric thief whose incessant hoarding is ruining trade. (A) Collect flawless pearls and trade them to Brithaur to satisfy his obsession peacefully: resolves the neighborhood dispute without shedding blood. (B) Assassinate Brithaur in a dark Crucible alley: permanently ends the nuisance, earning Earil's immediate gold reward. (C) Frame Brithaur for stealing royal Dark Seducer armor: lands the hoarder in the dungeons of Dementia, leaving Crucible merchants in peace.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_EVERYTHING_IN_ITS_PLACE: Cindanwe, a pathologically neat Altmer in New Sheoth, is driving the paranoid beggar Hirrus Clutumnus insane. (A) Infiltrate Cindanwe's house and misplace five of her possessions to break her rigid obsessive compulsions: drives her to eccentric madness, pleasing Dementia. (B) Counsel Hirrus Clutumnus on how to ignore her neatness: attempts mortal psychotherapy in a realm that defies mental order. (C) Steal all of Cindanwe's meticulously arranged clutter and toss it in the bay: cures her obsession through radical sensory deprivation.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_FALLING_AWAKE: Amiable Fanriene in Bliss cannot sleep because he fears the sky and ceilings are falling on him. (A) Convince Uungor to swap houses with Fanriene so he can sleep under the open sky: brings peaceful slumber to Fanriene and earns a minor ring blessing. (B) Cast a permanent paralysis and calm charm on Fanriene: puts him into an unnatural comatose sleep, resolving his terror through magical suspension. (C) Tell him the sky is indeed falling and the Greymarch is coming: pushes his phobia to apocalyptic extremes for cruel amusement.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_FINAL_RESTING: Hirrus Clutumnus in New Sheoth is utterly miserable and begs you to kill him, but it must look like an accident. (A) Shove Hirrus off the palace staircase or arrange an unobserved demise: grants the tragic mortal his wish for release, earning his enchanted ring. (B) Refuse to kill him, urging him to seek beauty in Mania's vibrant art: attempts to preserve his life, though Hirrus curses your unwanted mercy. (C) Convince a Dark Seducer guard to execute him for treason: orchestrates legal execution, satisfying his death wish through bureaucratic authority.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_GHOSTS_OF_THE_HILL_OF_SUIC: Four restless undead spirits wander the Hill of Suicides, unable to find peace until their skulls and relics are recovered. (A) Venture across the Shivering Isles, recover the skulls of Lorenz, Gadeneri, Limark, and Salonia, and lay their souls to rest: cleanses the hill and earns Arkay-like tranquility. (B) Bind the four tormented ghosts into your service as spectral guardians: harnesses their sorrow for necrotic combat power. (C) Burn their relics in the Sacellum Arden-Sul: sends their souls straight into the void of Sithis.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_GHOSTS_OF_VITHARN: The ruined fortress of Vitharn is trapped in an eternal spectral loop of cowardice and defeat against ghostly invaders. (A) Correct the fatal mistakes of the four spectral defenders—arm the archer, steady the cowardly count, rally the soldiers: breaks the eternal curse, freeing Vitharn's ghosts. (B) Slay the invading spectral warlord Malfegor single-handedly: breaks the siege through sheer martial power, though the cycle risks restarting. (C) Absorb the spectral memories into your own consciousness: claims the ancient tactical knowledge of First Era battle at the cost of hauntings.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_LEVELED_ITEM_QUESTS: Enchanted weaponry and armor across the Shivering Isles resonate with the shifting emotional climate of the realm. (A) Attune your relics to the vibrant manic energies of Bliss: maximizes speed, elemental shock, and chaotic spell output. (B) Attune your relics to the grim paranoid gloom of Crucible: maximizes damage reflection, poison resistance, and vampiric health absorption. (C) Balance both dualities within the relic forge: creates unstable, oscillating gear that shifts with the day-night cycle.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_MAIN_QUEST: The Greymarch approaches, and Sheogorath commands you to serve as his champion to avert the cycle of order. (A) Embrace the mantle of the Madgod's Champion, submitting to Sheogorath's surreal logic: prepares Tamriel for the ultimate struggle against Jyggalag. (B) Question the fundamental nature of the curse between Sheogorath and Jyggalag: delves into metaphysical duality before embarking on the defense of the realm. (C) Attempt to introduce Cyrodiilic imperial law and reason to the court: causes comical, bewildered chaos among the Golden Saints and Dark Seducers.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_MISCELLANEOUS_QUESTS: Bizarre, mad denizens across the towns of Split, Passwall, and Fellmoor petition the Champion with surreal requests. (A) Resolve the eccentric petitions with whimsical manic humor: spreads laughter and colorful delirium throughout the Isles. (B) Enforce harsh Demented discipline on insolent petitioning peasants: terrifies the populace into shivering respect. (C) Reorganize the provincial administration of the villages: tries to impose rational civic governance on inherently mad settlements.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_REBUILDING_THE_GATEKEEPER: The Gatekeeper of the Fringe was slain, and Relmyna Verenim requires exotic body parts to reconstruct a superior flesh golem. (A) Select the optimal body parts (electrified flesh, steel bones, weeping eye) to build an invincible Gatekeeper: secures the gates of New Sheoth against Jyggalag's forces. (B) Infiltrate Relmyna's torture garden and comfort her weeping subjects: shows mortal empathy in the heart of horrific flesh magic before choosing parts. (C) Sabotage the golem's heart with a hidden vulnerability: ensures the Champion can control or destroy the beast if it turns wild.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_RETAKING_THE_FRINGE: The Forces of Order have overrun Passwall, and the Knights of Order are marching on the Fringe. (A) Lead the Golden Saints or Dark Seducers into a ferocious counterattack, shattering the crystalline spires: drives Order out of Passwall and reclaims the Fringe. (B) Infiltrate behind the crystal lines and assassinate the commanding Knight of Order: collapses their hive-mind coordination with surgical precision. (C) Fortify Passwall with defensive siege engines: turns the town into an unyielding redoubt against the crystalline advance.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_RITUAL_OF_ACCESSION: To succeed Sheogorath, you must choose to become the ruler of either the House of Mania or the House of Dementia. (A) Choose the House of Mania, poisoning Thadon with a fatal overdose of Greenmote: ascends as Duke of Mania and claims the Golden Saint allegiance. (B) Choose the House of Dementia, carving out Syl's heart in the torture labyrinth: ascends as Duke of Dementia and claims the Dark Seducer allegiance. (C) Attempt to claim both thrones simultaneously: defies the Madgod's ancient bipartite political structure, risking reality fracture.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_RITUAL_OF_DEMENTIA: Pursue Duchess Syl through the twisting, trap-laden torture catacombs beneath Crucible to take her heart. (A) Navigate the lethal spike traps, execute the paranoid Duchess Syl in combat, and extract her heart: seals your ascension as Duke of Dementia. (B) Interrogate Syl regarding her secret defection to Jyggalag's Order: reveals how the fear of madness drives even royalty to embrace the rigid sterility of Order. (C) Spare Syl and allow her to flee into the crystalline mists: shows unprecedented mercy, though she returns as a commander of Order.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_RITUAL_OF_MANIA: Infiltrate Duke Thadon's private solarium and slip double the lethal dose of Greenmote into his evening meal. (A) Spike Thadon's chalice with Greenmote and watch him dance into cardiac euphoria and death: fulfills the ritual artistically to become Duke of Mania. (B) Challenge Thadon to a public duel of words and verse before the entire court: mocks his artistic decline before delivering the fatal poison. (C) Steal Thadon's Crown of Mania without killing him: tests whether the Madgod will accept symbolic coronation over biological sacrifice.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_SYMBOLS_OF_OFFICE: To forge the Staff of Sheogorath, you must recover the Eye of Ciirta from the Sunken Shrine and a branch of the Tree of Vanities. (A) Confront the blind heretic Ciirta in the dark, slay her acolytes, and claim her all-seeing eye: secures the primary component for the Staff of the Madgod. (B) Listen to Ciirta's tale of why she fled Cyrodiil during the Oblivion Crisis: gains tragic insight into mortal terror before extracting the eye. (C) Convince Ciirta's disillusioned followers to depose her themselves: takes the eye bloodlessly through cult mutiny.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_TAXONOMY_OF_OBSESSION: Mirili Ulven in Highcross wants to catalog every beast and flora in the Shivering Isles by capturing live specimens. (A) Subdue and herd live Elytra, Scalons, Gnarls, and Baliwogs back to Mirili's research pens: advances zoological knowledge and earns enchanted summoning rings. (B) Feed Mirili corrupted samples of crystalline Order flora: tests whether her taxonomy can comprehend Jyggalag's geometry. (C) Free the captured creatures from her pens into Highcross: unleashes wild beast chaos upon the reclusive scholarly village.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_THE_ANTIPODEAN_HAMMER: Cutter in Crucible and Dumag gro-Bonk in Bliss compete to forge master weapons from Madness Ore and Amber. (A) Commission heavy, spiked armor and crushing weapons from Cutter using dark Madness Ore: acquires supreme heavy defensive gear imbued with psychological dread. (B) Commission gleaming golden bows and agile armor from Dumag using radiant Amber: acquires master lightweight equipment humming with manic speed. (C) Combine Madness Ore and Amber into an alloy at the forge: attempts to forge impossible dual-aspected equipment, defying the realm's duality.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_THE_COLD_FLAME_OF_AGNON: Relight the Great Torch of New Sheoth by retrieving the Flame of Agnon from the sacred ruins of Cylarne. (A) Side with the Golden Saints or Dark Seducers to capture Cylarne and carry the holy flame back to New Sheoth: kindles the flame of either Mania or Dementia. (B) Negotiate a shared victory where both Saints and Seducers light the flame together: defies centuries of sectarian rivalry, establishing unprecedented unity in Cylarne. (C) Extinguish the flame with crystalline ice: plunges New Sheoth into spiritual darkness to observe the courtiers' terrified reactions.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_THE_COMING_STORM: Ahjazda in Crucible believes a catastrophic storm is coming and hoards survival relics to weather the apocalypse. (A) Track down the Amulet of Disintegration, Calming Pants, and Ring of Desiccation for Ahjazda: earns her gratitude and high-tier defensive enchantments. (B) Tell Ahjazda the storm is already inside her mind: attempts to talk her out of her doomsday hoarding, to no avail. (C) Keep the legendary survival relics for your own expedition: outfits yourself with bizarre enchanted curios.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_THE_END_OF_ORDER: The Greymarch reaches its climax: Jyggalag, the Daedric Prince of Order, steps into the Palace courtyard. (A) Duel and defeat Jyggalag in titan single combat, shattering his crystalline sword: breaks the eternal cosmic cycle, frees Jyggalag, and establishes you as the permanent Madgod. (B) Channel the chaotic madness of the entire Shivering Isles into a devastating wild-magic discharge: disintegrates the crystalline vanguard in a blaze of surreal wonder. (C) Question Jyggalag on whether perfect order is truly evil: debates the Prince of Logic on free will and madness before delivering the final strike.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_THE_FORK_OF_HORRIPILATION: Big Head in Bliss is desperate to recover his beloved holy relic, the Fork of Horripilation, guarded by Zealots. (A) Infiltrate Longtooth Camp, defeat the Zealots, and return the comical Fork to Big Head: earns master training in blade and sneak from an eccentric devotee. (B) Use the Fork of Horripilation in actual combat against netches and mudcrabs: experiences the absurd horror of wielding a utensil as a lethal weapon. (C) Give the Fork to Bolwing instead: spreads absurd relic worship to another New Sheoth eccentric.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_THE_GREAT_DIVIDE: The village of Split has been magically duplicated into two identical halves: a Manic population and a Demented population. (A) Systematically execute all the Demented clones at the behest of the Manic citizens: leaves Split joyfully eccentric and bright. (B) Systematically execute all the Manic clones at the behest of the Demented citizens: leaves Split grim, paranoid, and dark. (C) Refuse to kill either side, forcing the doubles to live side by side in perpetual absurdity: preserves the town's unique philosophical paradox.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_THE_HELPLESS_ARMY: The sanctuary of Brellach or Pinnacle Rock has been overrun by the Knights of Order, encasing the Saints or Seducers in crystal. (A) Infiltrate the crystalline depths, shatter the resonant fonts of order, and liberate the chained garrison: saves the proud warrior caste and secures their eternal devotion. (B) Use sonic resonance magic to shatter all crystal barriers simultaneously: maximizes speed, though sonic vibrations damage ancient architectural pillars. (C) Allow the crystalline fonts to convert fallen soldiers into Order automata: studies Jyggalag's conversion magic before cleansing the halls.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_THE_LADY_OF_PARANOIA: Duchess Syl is consumed by terror of an assassination plot and appoints you Grand Inquisitor to root out conspirators. (A) Use Herdir's shock tortures to interrogate citizens, exposing Ma'zaddha and Muurine's treason: protects Duchess Syl and secures her vicious approval. (B) Refuse to torture innocent suspects, relying solely on forensic evidence and eavesdropping: preserves your moral conscience in the dark alleys of Crucible. (C) Frame Syl's loyal bodyguard Kithlan for the plot: turns the Duchess's paranoia into self-destructive regicide.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_THE_MUSEUM_OF_ODDITIES: Una Armina runs the Museum of Oddities in Crucible and seeks 12 surreal and grotesque artifacts from across the Isles. (A) Hunt down all 12 bizarre relics (Two-Headed Coin, Hound's Tooth Key, Ring of Disrobing, Deformed Swamp Tentacle): creates the grandest exhibition of madness in history. (B) Curate the museum into an educational academy explaining the psychology of dementia: transforms an oddity show into a psychological study. (C) Steal back the exhibited relics to sell on the Cyrodiil black market: introduces Shivering Isles surrealism to astonished Imperial collectors.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_THE_PARANOID_ROOF_WATCHER: Ushnar gro-Shadlog in Crucible despises Khajiit and will pay handsomely if you remove a dog-loving beggar named Bhisha. (A) Lure Bhisha out of Crucible by befriending him and providing him food in Bliss: resolves Ushnar's prejudice peacefully without bloodshed. (B) Assassinate Bhisha in his alley while he sleeps: secures Ushnar's skeletal hound reward through cold cruelty. (C) Unleash a pack of wild dogs on Ushnar: subjects the prejudiced Orc to ironic, poetic justice.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_THE_PRINCE_OF_MADNESS: Sheogorath vanishes, transforming into Jyggalag, leaving the throne empty as the sky turns into shattered crystal. (A) Cleanse the Fonts of Madness, forge the Staff of Sheogorath in the Font of Mania and Dementia, and claim the throne: assumes the divine mantle of the Prince of Madness. (B) Attempt to abandon the Shivering Isles and return to Cyrodiil to escape the Greymarch: tests whether a mortal can truly escape the fate of the Madgod. (C) Rally the remaining mortal courtiers of New Sheoth to stand against the storm: unites mortals and Daedra in a desperate final defense.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_THE_ROOTS_OF_MADNESS: Order has poisoned the primordial Tree of Madness beneath the palace with dark crystals, draining the realm's magic. (A) Clear the corruption from the Fountain of Mania and Dementia, cleansing the roots with pure chaotic waters: restores the vibrant pulse of New Sheoth. (B) Harness the crystalline corruption to forge a hybrid weapon of Order and Chaos: creates an unprecedented artifact of balanced cosmic forces. (C) Overdose the roots with concentrated Greenmote: shock-therapizes the Tree of Madness, risking botanical collapse.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_THROUGH_THE_FRINGE_OF_MADN: Arrive in Passwall, where adventurers are slaughtered by the monstrous Gatekeeper guarding the gates of the realm. (A) Learn of the Gatekeeper's vulnerability from Relmyna's tears or bone arrows, and slay the titan: opens the Gates of Madness to enter the realm proper. (B) Lure an army of Cyrodiilic adventurers into the Gatekeeper's path to wear it down: sacrifices reckless fortune-seekers to breach the threshold. (C) Commune with the Gatekeeper using beast empathy: glimpses the tortured soul stitched into the flesh golem before ending its misery.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_TO_HELP_A_HERO: Pyke, a former Knight of the Thorn, has lost his ceremonial medallion to the Grummites in Fetid Grove and longs for honor. (A) Infiltrate Fetid Grove, slay the Grummite shamans, and return the medallion to Pyke: restores his warrior dignity, allowing him to stay in the Isles with his lover. (B) Keep the enchanted medallion for yourself: claims its defensive wards while leaving Pyke brooding in disgrace. (C) Persuade Pyke to return to Cheydinhal and rejoin the Knights of the Thorn: encourages the errant knight to face his mortal past.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_UNDERSTANDING_MADNESS: Sheogorath commands you to explore both the vibrant heights of Mania and the paranoid depths of Dementia. (A) Meet with Thadon in the Halcyon Conservatory and Syl in the House of Dementia, studying their psychologies: masters the delicate balance governing the Shivering Isles. (B) Incite an argument between the Duke and Duchess during court: disrupts royal diplomacy for the sheer amusement of Sheogorath. (C) Attempt to diagnose the court's mental illnesses using Cyrodiilic psychiatric terminology: baffles the courtiers with mortal medical theories.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_USHNARS_TERROR: Ushnar gro-Shadlog has an irrational terror of cats and wants the Khajiit beggar Bhisha banished from Crucible. (A) Persuade Bhisha to relocate to the cat-friendly streets of Bliss: ends Ushnar's panic without violence and receives an obedient undead hound. (B) Give Bhisha a stray cat to follow him around: terrorizes Ushnar with his phobia, driving the Orc deeper into hysterics. (C) Slay Ushnar to rid Crucible of an abusive bully: cleanses the district of an aggressive brute.
Q_OBLIVION_SI_WORK_IS_NEVER_DONE: Tove the Unrestful in Bliss is frantically building a sky-boat and requires massive amounts of calipers and tongs. (A) Collect and deliver 100 calipers and tongs from across Tamriel to Tove: satisfies his manic engineering dream and earns hefty coin. (B) Build him an authentic scale model of a sailing ship to prove the sky-boat's impossibility: tries to gently burst his manic delusion. (C) Steal Tove's blueprints and sell them to an eccentric engineer in the Imperial City: monetizes mad aeronautical theory in mortal Cyrodiil.
